tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swasti singnghaṃ/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad pas | dus gcig gi tshe 'od tshogs kyi dbus na rin po che'i khri gcig gi steng na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dmar ser chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ bzang po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' gnyis g.yas g.yon du gnas pa mngon sum gzigs te gtso bo'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ khams gsum la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la dpyad pas | pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi nyams len thams cad zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba'i blo sbyong du 'du bar dgongs te/ chos thams cad la nges shes khyad par can thob pa yin no/ /sa māpta mi thi// // ༄༅/ /zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bka' drin can gyi bla ma dang*/ /thugs rje can gyi yi dam lha/ / snying nas skyabs su mchi lags kyi/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / chos min gyi spyod pa dgos rgyu med/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa la/ /zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag 'tshal/ /de khyed kyi snyan du gsol bar mchod brjod dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba bstan to// bgyi/ /tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /dang po tshe 'dir ma zhen par/ /tshul khrims dang thos bsam bsgom pa gsum/ /tshe 'di la dmigs nas bsgrub pa de/ /chos pa min gyi bshol la zhog /thog mar tshul khrims bshad tsam na/ /mtho ris bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /thar pa bsgrub pa'i them skas can/ /sdug bsngal spong ba'i gnyen po can | | tshul khrims la med thabs mi gda' ste/ /tshe 'di la zhen pa'i tshul khrims de/ /chos brgyad bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/

/tshul khrims ngan la gshe ba can | | tshul khrims ldan la phrag dog can/ /rang gi tshul khrims ngo phag can/ / ngan 'gro bsgrub pa'i sa bon can/ /bcos ma'i tshul khrims bshol la zhog / thos bsam byed pa'i gang zag de/ /shes bya bsgrub pa'i longs spyod can/ /ma rig sel ba'i sgron me can/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i lam rgyus can/ /chos kyi sku yi sa bon can/ /thos bsam la med thabs mi gda' ste/ /tshe 'di la zhen pa'i thos bsam de/ /nga rgyal bsgrub pa'i longs spyod can/ /thos bsam dman la brnyas pa can/ /thos bsam ldan la phrag dog can/ /'khor dang longs spyod tshol ba can/ /ngan 'gro bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /chos brgyad kyi thos bsam bshol la zhog /sgom pa bgyid pa'i gang zag kun/ /nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po can/ /thar lam bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i longs spyod can/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i sa bon can/ /sgom pa la med thabs mi gda' ste/ /tshe 'di la dmigs pa'i sgom pa de/ /dben par bsdad kyang 'du 'dzi can/ /long gtam smra ba'i kha ton can/ /thos bsam byed la skur ba can/ /sgom pa gzhan la phrag dog can/ / ¡Ã rang gi sgom pa rnam g.yeng can | | ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - rang gi g.yeng can/ / ) chos brgyad kyi bsam gtan bshol la zhog | 'di yan chad kyis/ mngon par mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa'i/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la yang dag dang ltar snang gi dbye ba dngos su bstan to/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom tshul shugs las bstan to// mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub pa la/ khams gsum la zhen pa spang yang 'tshal/ khams gsum la zhen pa spong ba la/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa dran par 'tshal/ /dang po sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal de/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yin/ /de legs par bsams na skyi sha 'bung*/ /thog tu babs na bsran thabs med/ /spong ba'i dge ba mi bsgrub par/

/ngan song gi so nam byed byed po/ /de gang na 'dug kyang the le le/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsams tsa na/ /mtho ris ngan 'gror 'gro ba yod/ /brgya byin tha mal du skye ba yod/ /nyi zla mun par 'gro ba yod/ / sgyur rgyal bran du skye ba yod/ /de lung la brten nas yid ches kyang*/ /phal pas rtogs par mi nus pas/ /rang snang mi yi 'gyur ba ltos/ /mi phyug po sprang por 'gro yin 'dug kha drag po zhan por 'gro yin 'dug /mi mang po gcig tu 'gro yin 'dug /de la sogs pa bsam mi khyab/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsams tsa na/ /bya ba'i las la zin pa med/ /mi mang yang sdug la nyung yang sdug | nor phyug kyang sdug la ltogs kyang sdug /mi tshe thams cad grabs la zad | | grabs byed pa'i 'phro la thams cad 'chi/ /shi yang grabs la zin pa med | | tshe phyi ma'i grabs kyi 'go la 'jug /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi phung po la | | zhen par byed rnams the le 'di yan chad kyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dngos su bstan nas/ las 'bras kyi blang dor shugs las bstan to// le/ /zhen pa bral na mya ngan 'da'/ / mya ngan 'das na bde ba thob/ /zhen pa bzhi bral nyams kyi byangs/ /bdag gcig pu thar bas phan rgyu med/ khams gsum sems can pha ma yin/ /pha ma sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag /bdag bde bar 'dod pa the le le/ khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi bsod nams sems can khyer | | bsod nams 'di yi byin rlabs kyis/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 'di yan chad kyis rgyu byams pa dang snying rje bsgom pa shugs las bstan nas/ 'bras bu bdag gzhan brje ba dngos su bstan to/ / shog /bdag ji ltar 'dug kyang chos nyid kyi ngang*/ 'dzin dang bcas la grol ba med/ /de yang zhib tu bshad tsam na/ /yod par 'dzin la thar pa med/ /med par 'dzin la mtho ris med/ /gnyis kar 'dzin pa mi shes kyis/ /gnyis med kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog

/ 'di yan chad kyis rtag chad kyi lta ba spangs nas zung 'jug gnyis med la blo 'jog tshul spyir bstan to/ / chos kun sems kyi spyod yul yin/ /phywa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa/ /'byung bzhi'i byed mkhan ma tshol bar/ /sems nyid kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog / 'di yan chad kyis byang sems sems tsam pa dang thun mong pa'i lam rim bstan nas/ theg chen dbu ma pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam ni | snang ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang*/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ / gnas lugs brjod par mi shes kyi/ /brjod bral gyi ngang la gang dgar zhog / 'di yan chad kyis zhi gnas bsgom tshul shugs las bstan nas/ lhag mthong bsgom tshul la/ yul snang sems su bsgrub pa dang*/ de sgyu mar bsgrub pa dang*/ de rang bzhin med pa/ rten 'brel dang*/ brjod bral du gtan la phab nas/ spros bral zung 'jug bsgom pa dngos su bstan to/ zhen pa bzhi bral bshad pa yi/ /dge ba 'di yi bsod nams kyis/ /'gro ba bdun po ma lus pa | | sangs rgyas sa la 'god par 'dis bsngo ba dang 'bras bu bstan to/ / shog /zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /ye shes rdo rje la gnang ba'i nyams dbyangs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru we/ dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad la/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa skya'i rje btsun yab sras la/ /snying nas dad pas skyabs su mchi/ /dal 'byor skyon med dad pa can/ /lam bsgrub pa la yan lag rnam dgu dgos/ /bcu gnyis tshang na sangs rgyas 'ong*/ /gang zag rnam gnyis ( ¡¶ zha ¡· gsum ¡¶ lu ¡· - gnyis ) gang du song*/ /yan lag dgu po bshad tsa na// bla ma smin byed dam tshig gsum/ /thos rgya dang man ngag brtson 'grus gsum/ / gnas dang cha rkyen grogs dang gsum/ /de tsho yan lag rnam dgu lags/ /dang po bla ma tshol ba na/ khong thos rgya can la man ngag med/ /man ngag can la mkhyen rgya med/

/gnyis po tshang la bsgrub tshugs med/ /gsum po tshang la thugs rje med/ /bzhi po tshang la brtson 'grus med/ /lnga ldan gyi bla ma tshol tshol nas// lam bsgrub pa la lo 'ga' 'gyangs te thal/ /rang ma smin par bsgrub la dgos rgyu med/ /smin byed bla ma dam pa 'tshal/ /smin pa'i cha rkyen bsgrigs bsgrigs nas/ /lam bsgrub pa la lo 'ga' 'gyangs te thal/ /dam tshig ma bsrungs 'bras bu med/ /thos pa med na shes rab med/ /man ngag med na snying po med/ /de gsum gyi cha rkyen bsgrigs bsgrigs nas/ /lam bsgrub pa la lo 'ga' 'gyangs te thal/ /sngar 'gyangs te don med du ma gyur lags/ /bdag gang zag cha rkyen gsum yang tshang*/ /dgos pa'i yan lag rnam dgu 'phrod/ /da brtson 'grus lcag gis bskul byas nas/ /bsgrub pa la le lo mi bgyid 'tshal | | lam bsgrub par 'dod pas dben gnas btsal/ /dben par bsdad na rkun po 'byung*/ /tshogs pa'i dbus su g.yeng bas khyer/ /gar sdod kyi bsam mno btang btang nas/ /grabs la zad du ma 'jug par/ /dben par sdod pa'i yo byad kun/ /tshogs par byas la dben pa btsal/ /gang du bsdad kyang g.yeng ba bskyungs/ /bsgrub pa'i nan tan ma shol cig /yo byad mang na g.yeng ba che/ /yo byad nyung na mthun rkyen zhan/ /'di gnyis kyi bsam mno btang btang nas/ /lam bsgrub pa la g.yel du ma gzhug cig /yo byad yod na tshogs sog bya/ /yo byad sna tshogs ma tshogs kyang*/ /yo byad ci snyed kyi zas gos spyad/ /dman pa'i spyod pas rang sems 'dul/ /dman spyod kyang tho chor song ba mchi'o/ /grogs mang na g.yeng ba bdud kyis khyer/ /grogs gnyis kyang gtam gyis bar du gcod/ /chos bzhin mthun pa'i gang zag dang*/ /gtam 'jam po mi thos tsam du bsdad/ /de 'dra'i grogs dang ma 'phrad na/ /gcig pur bsdad la rang sems 'dul/ /mthun pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis tshang*/ / 'gal rkyen gyi skyon rnams thams cad spongs/

/da le lo'i dbang du mi gtang bar | | bsgrub pa la nan tan mdzad par zhu/ /bsgrub pa 'dod na dal bar sdod | | cha rkyen 'gṛg nas dal bar bsdad/ /thos bsam gyis dub nas dal bar bsdad/ /yul ci 'dra bsams nas dal bar bsdad/ /nyin bya rgyu med de yul la blta/ /spros pa ldan pas bsam mno btang*/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i yon tan dran/ /yon tan 'di ru bshad par bya/ /sgrib med tha mal mig gis ni | | dby-ibs dang kha dog du ma can/ /gzugs la bltas pas spro ba bskyed/ / nang du bltas shing dga' ba bskyed/ /'gags med tha mal gyi rna ba yis/ / ¡Ã sgra sna tshogs mnyan pas ngo mtshar bskyed/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - sgra sna mtshar bskyed/ ) sgra sna tshogs mnyan pas blo gros 'phel/ /gtam sna tshogs gtong gis spro ba bskyed// 'gags med tha mal gyi sna lce yis/ /yul ngo mtshar can gyi dri ro spyad/ /myong ba sna tshogs ngo mtshar skyes/ /gzhan la byin zhing spro ba bskyed/ /tha mal nad med lus dbang gis/ /skyon med kyi reg bya du ma yis/ /spro ba bskyed cing gzhan la'ang sbyin/ /blo gzhan yang spro ba skye bar 'gyur/ /skyon med kyi bsam mno btang ba yis/ /dus gsum gyi yon tan sna tshogs skye/ /shes rab 'phel zhing spro bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma rgas te mal du bsdad/ /gnyid med kyi bsam mno 'phyo nas song*/ /nyin bsam gyi bsam mno 'khrul nas 'dug /mtshan mor 'khor ba'i nyes pa dran/ /yul spyad pas tshim par ma mthong ste/ /tshim yang snying po yang ma mthong*/ /snying po med pa'i snying po can/ /yul spyod 'dod kyi bsam pa the le le/ /tshim med kyi yul la spyod spyod nas/ /nyi ma kun gang thal tshad kyang med | | tshim med kyi dgos pa bsgrubs bsgrubs nas/ /lo zla kun gar thal tshod kyangamed/ /snying po med pa'i snying po btsal/ /dgos pa med la dgos pa brtags | | don med kyi spun ma g.yeng g.yeng nas/ /yul gzhan du gyur pa ma tshor ro/

/skra dkar gyi mtshe bas mgo bzung nas/ /pags pa la gnyer ma'i rol gyis bris/ kha la so med rnyil la thug /lus la stobs med 'khar bar brten | | na tshod dar ma kun gyis brnyas/ /lus rgas pa 'chi bas rtsa nas bsnyen | | rgas kyang da dung rtag blo can/ /gzhon la ma shi lha re che/ /rgan gzhon gang yang mi phan pas/ /'byung ba 'khrug pa'i skye shis gdungs/ /'go ba'i lha rnams gzhan du song*/ /gnod pa'i 'dre gdon drung du btud/ /lus stobs med la gzhan gyis rten/ kha zas dang btung bas sles la bor/ /lus la sdug bsngal du mas gtses/ /gnyen 'dun yod na ngu 'bod byed/ /'chi bdag gshin rjes rab tu gtses/ /'jig rten 'di yi snang ba dor/ /sa tshigs gar 'gro tshod kyang med/ /mun pa chen pos kun tu khyab/ /las kyi gshin rjes rgyab nas 'ded/ /ngan 'gro 'jigs pa'i sgra yang thos/ /de tshe bsod nams skyabs yin na/ /de yang bdag gis ma bsten no/ /sngar yang yul la spyad pa yis/ / phan med gnod pa du ma byung*/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ma bsams pas/ /blo tha mal du btang ba the le le/ /nam langs te dben par gcig pur bsdad/ / mdang 'khor ba'i nyes pa dran pa yi/ /bsam mno yar btang mar btang nas// thar pa'i gnas la 'dod pa skyes/ /de gang gis bsgrub snyam bsam pa yis/ / shes rab thabs dang spyod pa gsum/ /legs par bsams na grol ba las/ / thog mar shes rab kyi lta ba skyes/ /sngar bzhin nyin gyi bsam mno 'khrul/ / yul sna tshogs rab bkra'i ngo mtshar can/ /ngo mtshar can la bltas pa yis/ / snying po med pa'i snying po mthong*/ /yang dag don gyi snying po rnyed/ /yul la bltas pas ngos gzung med/ /snying po med de gang dgar zhog /gzugs la bltas pas ngos gzung med/ /gzugs gzung med kyi ngang la lhug par zhog / gzugs snang ba me long gi gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /sgyu ma lta bur gang dgar zhog/ sgra mnyan pas ngos gzung ma rnyed de/

/ci grag brag ca 'dra bar 'dug /sgra skye ba med par brtags pa yi/ /grag stong gi ngang la lhug par zhog /bsnam pa dang reg pa myang ba gsum/ /yul skye ba dang 'gags par mthong ba na/ /myong ba snang ba gzugs brnyan tsam/ /rig stong gi ngang la lhug par zhog /sems bsam pas bsam rgyu ma rnyed de/ /gang bsams kyang skye 'gag mi rnyed pas/ /mtha' dbus med de nam mkha' 'dra/ /skye med kyi ngang la lhug par zhog /yul mtho ba dang dma' ba gang yang med/ / ¡Ã skye ba dang 'gag pa gang yang med/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - skye ba yang med/ / ) bzang ba dang ngan pa gang yang med/ /chos mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang la zhog /mdang bsams pa'i bsam mno 'khrul nas 'dug/ma skyes pa la skye bar bsam/ /na rga med par de nyid bsam/ /'gag pa med la 'gag par bsam | | chos thog mar skyes ba med pa la/ /gnas pa dang 'gag pa ga la srid | | skye 'gag med par bsam pa yi/ /rnam rtog 'phel bas zhog la thong*// gzhog pa rang yang zhog la thong*/ /'jog pa rang yang rnam rtog yin/ /rang byung gi gnas lugs ma rtogs shing*/ /'dzin med kyi gdams ngag ma goms pas// ji ltar bsams kyang 'dzin par song*/ /'dzin med bsams kyang 'dzin par song

| | gsal ba ma 'gags kyi bdag med yin/ /zung 'jug gi gnas lugs rtogs par shog /bsgom pa bgyi ba'i rtse gcig de/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i lag na gda'/ /bying rgod kyi dgra la ma bskur bar/ /zhi gnas dang lhag mthong lam du gyis/ /de sgrub pa'i gdams ngag zab mo de/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde'i nang na yod/ /gsang sngags glu ru mi blang gis/ /man ngag kun rang gi sems la chongs/ /spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa yis/ /so sor thar pa rigs bdun po/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan zhig go /de sgrub pa la nan tan bskyed pa yis/ /lus ngag tho cor mi 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi 'gal ba | | 'gro ba gshe skur mi 'debs pa/ /tha mal du yan par mi gtong ba/ / 'di phan yon che yis nan tan skyed/ /rtsa ba yin gyis ma g.yel zhig /gzhi de dang ldan pa'i gang zag la/ /gsang sngags kyi spyod pa rnam gsum yod/ /spros bcas de 'byor pa dka' yi shol/ /spros med dam shin tu spros med de/ /gang 'grub ltos la nan tan skyed/ /tshig 'di tsho bzhin du bsgrub byas na/ /sangs rgyas de rang gi lag na 'dug /yun mi ring bar rang gi lag na 'dug /tshegs med du 'bras bu 'grub pa yin/ /dpal sa skya'i ri sgang nub phyogs su/ khams g.yeng bar 'dod de phyin tsam na/ /dad pa can ye shes rdo rje 'ong*/ /gnas lugs kyi don dang mi 'gal bar/ /bsams na rtogs pa skye ba yi/ /don ldan gyi tshigs bcad bris shig zer/ /rig 'dzin grags pa khrid de 'ong*/ khyod yi ge'i rkyen gyis bris shig byas/ /skabs su bklags na rtogs pa skye/ /bsam mno btang na sems la phan/ /gzhan la phan pa 'ong srid kyi/ /glu mgur gyi rta la bskyon la long*/ / ¡Ã rje btsun chen po lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ /'di bris dge ba bdag gis gang thob des/ /mkha' mnyam sems can ji snyed thams cad kyis/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog///

( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· - rje btsun thob shog// ) ༄༅/ khams bde dri ba'i nyams dbyangs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rje bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud/ /gnas skabs kyi lo rgyus bshad tsam na/ /bdag las kyi 'brel ba mang lags pas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· pa ) / /nangs nub tu phrad kyang khams bde 'dri/ / ¡Ã yul gzhan du phyin kyang khams so 'dri// yul gzhan nas log kyang khams so 'dri/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - yul gzhan so 'dri/ ) khams so bde na dga' lags te/ khams bde ba'i rten 'brel nyung bar gda'/ /sgyu ma'i lus la nad gzhi mang*/ /brjod pa'i ngag la 'dzar 'dzer mang*/ /gsal ba'i sems la sdug bsngal mang*/ /yul chags sdang gnyis kyis lus sems phrogs// rnam rtog gi las la zin dus med/ /de 'khor bar skyes pas nyes pa yin/ / 'khor ba las thar na dga' lags te/ / ¡Ã 'khor ba las thar ba'i rten 'brel nyung*/ /dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs la/ /skye med stong pa yin mod kyang | | 'khrul pa'i bag chags mthug pa dang*/ /dngos 'dzin rtsad nas ma chod pas | khams gsum 'khor ba'i khong stong du/ /dug lnga dug gsum gyi 'tshub ma langs | | las ngan sna tshogs kyi bud shing la/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi me chen 'bar/ /gnyug ma rang sems kyi sdong po tshig /byang chub kyi myu gu thal bar btang | | rigs drug sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo de/ /mgal me bzhin du rgyun du 'khor | | skye rga na 'chi'i dpyangs thag la/ /dus yang nas yang du 'ju yin gda' | | thar dus med pa'i btson dong na/ /rang sems bcings pa'i brtson re sdug /thar pa'i dus med snying re rje/ /snying re rje ste bya thabs med/ /bya thabs yod de byed mkhan med/ /e ma'o 'gro ba nyon re mongs/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi mgur i thi ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· - 'khor ba mgur i thi ) // //༈ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /rje bla mas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag dben par bsdad nas bsam mno btang*/

/da ci yi bsam mno 'khrul nas 'dug /bdag mi bde ma mchis bde mor gda'/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' thob ste bde/ /theg chen gyi chos dang mjal te bde/ /yang dag gi bla ma bsten te bde/ /gsang sngags kyi chos dang phrad de bde/ /rgyud tshul bzhin du smin par bgyis te bde/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrungs te bde// lam rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms te bde/ /zab mo'i spyod pa bsgrubs te bde | | yul snang bas sems la gnod pa med/ /yul snying po med de brdzun par 'dug /gzugs me long gi gzugs brnyan 'dra ba la/ /zhen pa brtsams kyang snying po med/ /yul gsum kyang de dang 'dra bar 'dug /sgra thos tshad brag ca 'dra ba la/ /chags sdang brtsams kyang snying po med/ /ci bsams kyang sgyu mar blo thag chod/ /sgyu ma'i ngang la bde bar 'dug /sgyu ma btsal bas brjod du med | | brjod bral gyi ngang la bde mor 'dug /'khor ba btsal kyang ma rnyed pa | | de mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /gnyis med kyi ngang la bde mor 'dug /sdug bsngal btsal kyang ma rnyed pa/ /bde ba chen po'i rangabazhin yin | | zung 'jug gi ngang la bde mor 'dug /'khor ba spang du med pa la/ / spang blo ma skyes rnal 'byor pa/ / ¡Ã sangs rgyas bsgrub tu med pa la/ /bsgrub blo ma skyes rnal 'byor pa/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - sangs rgyas 'byor pa// ) 'khor 'das med par go ba de/ /'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba yin/ /dbyer med kyi ngang la bde mor gda'/ /'di ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bsgrub rgyu med kyang bsgrub la brtson/ /bsgom rgyu med kyang bsgom la brtson/ /bsrung rgyu med kyang dam tshig bsrung | | de ltar shes na bde ste mchi/ /mi bdag kyang de ga'i ngang la gda'/ / bu khyod kyang de ga'i ngang la zhog /thob med byang chub thob nas mchis/ /bsgrub rgyu med pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /rang gi sems la yod pa yin/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡·

+ sgrub med kyi sangs rgyas thob nas kyang*/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog / ) blo mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis/ /rje btsun gyi man ngag dam pa 'di/ /ye shes rdo rjes bskul nas kyang | | bdag gis 'bad de bris pa yin/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + dad pa can ye shes rdo rjes bskul/ / ) lcags mo yos lo dbyar zla 'bring po la/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis khams bsangs la mdzad do// // ༄༅/ /chog pa drug gi 'gur bzhugs/ / ༈ bdag cag dam pa'i lha chos byed pa la/ /rgyab rten du dkon mchog gis chog par byung*/ /sdod sa ru spyil pos chog par byung*/ /sdod grogs su yi dam gyis chog par byung*/ /smra grogs su bzlas pas chog par byung*/ / 'jigs grogs su yi dam gyis chog par byung*/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + zas su ting 'dzin gyis chog par byung*// ) chog pa drug ( ¡¶ zha ¡· lnga ) rje btsun rin po che'i gsung ngo*/ /i thi// // ༄༅/ /gnas bstod kyi nyams dbyangs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ / ¡Ã dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa dang*/ /yi dam gyi lha la skyabs su mchi/ /skabs su rnam rtog yan pa yi/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - dus gsum pa yi/ / ) bsam mno 'phyos pa'i lo rgyus yin/ /chos byed par 'dod pa'i dad can dang*/ /chos la zhugs pa'i dad can gnyis/ /de gnyis la bsam mno btang ba yis/ /rnam rtog kha 'byam du ma skyes/ /dang po dad can mang mod kyi/ /dad pa la la col chung yin/ /dad pa la la tho co yin/ /dad pa la la 'dre gdon yin/ /dad pa la la snying nas yin/ /dang po col chung gi dad pa de/ /dad pa skyes nas co spu breg/ dad pa log nas mi chos byed/ /phar log tshur log du ma byed/ /legs par brtags nas mi byed pa/ /de col chung gi dad pa ma lags sam/ /dad pa la la tho co ste/ /dang por dge bshes mi brtag par/ /gang yang rung ba'i sgo ru zhugs | | chos ci bya cha med tho cor shor/

/res 'ga' ri gsum gyi rtse la bsdad | | dben par bsdad nas bsgom rgyu med/ /res 'ga' lung gsum gyi mdo ru bsdad/ /tshogs pa'i gseb tu tho cor shor/ /mkhas btsun rnams kyis khrel te mchis/ / ¡Ã de tho co'i dad pa ma lags sam/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· chos ci bya cha med rgod re bro/ / ) dad pa la la 'dre gdon te/ /chos la zhugs nas tho co byed/ /skye bo rnams kyi rol mo ba/ /dam pa rnams kyi gting bslad pa/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka phung ba'i rgyu/ /chos la snyad btags smyon pa yin/ /de 'dre gdon gyi dad pa ma lags sam/ /snying nas kyi dad pa bya ba de/ /dang po dang ba'i dad pa skyes | | chos byed par 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis/ /myur du tsab tsob ma lags par | | thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal/ /tshul khrims dang sdom par ldan pa can/ /mdo rgyud kyi don la sbyangs pa can/ /byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa can/ /de gang na 'dug pa'i drung du bsnyag /des ji skad gsungs pa'i spyod pa bya/ /chos la zhugs pa'i dad can de/ /la la tshul khrims ci tshugs bsrung*/ / thos pa med na snyingapo med/ /la la mi tshe thos par 'byam/ /sgom med yid la ci zhig bya/ /la la thos pa med par bsgom/ /thos pa med par ci bsgom med/ / la la dad med las thabs byed/ /chos brgyad kyi so nam ci zhig byed/ /la la dad can sgrub gnas tshol/ /de zhib tu bshad na 'di ltar yin/ /la la rdo rje gdan du 'gro/ /rdo rje gdan du mu stegs mang/ /de dag la yang grub pa med/ / lam khar mi rkun 'jigs pa mang*/ /ol pa bcad nas 'gyod grir 'chi/ /la la ti se'i gangs la 'gro/ /ti se'i gangs la 'brog pa mang*/ /'brog pas mi dge sna tshogs byed/ /rang gangs log gis bsad nas 'gyod grir 'chi/ /la la tsa ri tsa gong 'gro /yul phyogs kla klo mon gyis khengs/ /chos kyi sgra skad ming yang med/ /rang 'dre gdon gyis bsad nas 'gyod grir 'chi/ /de la sogs te mtha' yas mod/

/sgrub gnas mang por mi 'tshol bar/ /mthun rkyen 'grig pa'i dben sa ru/ /rim gnyis gdengs dang ldan par bsgom/ /rang gang du gnas pa 'og min gnas/ /grogs su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha/ /ci za dang ci 'thung bdud rtsi'i zas/ /phyi rol du sgrub gnas mi 'tshol ba/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i ¡Ã dam tshig ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dam ngag ) yin/ /de glu ru mi len shol la zhog | nga sdod sa'i dpal ldan sa skya 'di/ /'og min gyi gnas dang mthun par 'dug | shar gra chung gaṅgā glang po'i sna/ /zung 'jug gis 'gro ba 'dren pa po/ / rje mi bskyod rdo rje'i bzhugs gnas yin/ /lho kha'u gtsang po rin chen rta/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa 'gengs pa can/ /rje rin chen 'byung gnas kyi bzhugs gnas yin | | nub chu mig rdzing kha rma bya'i mdongs/ /'gro ba chos la 'dren pa po/ /rje 'od dpag med pa'i bzhugs gnas yin/ /byang spun po ri 'di mkha' lding gshog | 'gro ba'i don rnams sgrub byed pa/ /rje don yod grub pa'i bzhugs gnas yin/ /sa dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa 'dra/ /dpal ldan sa skya seng ge'i lus | | 'gro drug gi bsam pa 'gengs pa po/ /rje rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugs gnas yin/ /de 'dra'i 'og min gnas mchog na/ /nga rdo rje 'chang gi rnal 'byor bde/ /spros pa chod pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /rig sngags kyi go cha sra bas bde | | man ngag gi mdzod dang ldan pas bde/ /lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pas bde | | dam tshig gi ra bas chod pas bde/ /bdag gcig pu'i kha pho ma lags te | | 'di bzhin kun la 'dog lags pas/ /yul kun tu 'khyams shing ma 'gro bar/ /dal 'byor don med ma btang zhing*/ /lus srog don med du ma btang bar/ /rang rtogs tshad yod na dben par sdod/ /rtogs tshad med na bla ma bsten/ /gang ltar yang sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /dad pa chud zos su ma btang bar/ /bsam mno 'phyo ba'i glu chung 'di/ /dad can ye shes rdo rjes khyer

| | gzhungs pa bsgom ston la yang spring*/ /glu mgur gyi rta la bskyon cing long | | i thi// ༄༅/ /rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi nyams dbyangs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grong dang gnas gzhi tshong 'dus gsum/ /sems dmu rgod rta yi 'phyo sa lags/ /lhag mthong gi skyes bu ngan pa dang*/ /zhi gnas kyi srab phyogs zhan pa yis/ /rta dmu rgod kha lo ma 'chings pa/ /las ngan gyi thang la brgyugs brgyugs nas/ /sdug bsngal gyi g.yang sar bskyur nyen yod/ /ri dwags rmas ma byung ba bzhin/ /dben par sdod la nyams su long*/ /mang po 'tshogs na rtsod pa 'phel/ /gnyis su bsdad na long gtam 'phel/ /gzhon nu ma yi dwa ( ¡¶ lu ¡· gdu ) bu bzhin/ /rang gcig pur sdod pa nyams su long*/ /phyogs ris grwa pa'i nyams dga' dang*/ /dge 'dun sde pa'i brtsi bzhag gnyis/ /yon bdag pho mo'i bsnyen bkur gsum/ / 'di gsum bdud kyi phye gtor lags/ /chos chags med tshul du nyams su long | | snang ba la zhen pa che dang gcig /nor rdzas la 'dzin pa che dang gnyis | | zas skom la chags pa che dang gsum/ /'di gsum sgom chen gyi dmu chu lags/ /yid 'dzin med kyi rtsa bshal drag tu thong*/ /chos bu chung gi tshul du nyams su long*/ /dran pa nyams pa'i chang dang gcig /snying rje nyams pa'i sha dang gnyis/ /grags pa nyams pa'i bud med gsum/ /'di gsum sgom chen gyi khong skran lags/ /nges 'byung gi me btsa' myur du thob/ /chos smyon pa'i tshul du nyams su long*/ /nad pa'i sngas srung byed dang gcig/phyug po'i sri bu gso dang gnyis | | log 'tsho'i mngon shes bshad dang gsum/ /'di gsum sgom chen gyi lam log lags/ /bsnyen bkur bdud du shes par brjod/ /chos 'dris med tshul du nyams su long*/ /zhi gnas rkyang pa'i bde ba dang*/ /ro myang mtshungs ldan ma rig pa/ /snying rje bral ba'i stong sgom gsum/ /'di gsum sgom chen gyi gol sa lags/

khyung chen mkha' la lding pa bzhin/ /chos zung 'jug gi tshul du nyams su long*/ /mos gus can gyi slob ma dang*/ /las kyis 'brel ba'i gnyen dang gnyis/ /dam tshig can gyi mched lcam gsum/ /snang ba thugs phrad du 'grogs mdzod la/ /'phral la gdung sems ma che bar/ /chos rmi lam tshul du nyams su long*/ /rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi dbyangs/ i thi// ༄༅/ /gnyen po bsten tshul nyams dbyangs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ sems kyi rang so ma tshugs pas/ /ci byas sems la bde dus med/ /chos rnams sems su ma shes pas/ /kun brtags kyi mtshan ma sna tshogs su/ /'khrul snang khyod la yid ma ches/ /da sprang po'i mtshan ma la ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - la ) rtog nyan med/ /mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob byang chub kyi lam | | lam de kun phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ kha zas bdud rtsir ma shes pas/ / zas bzang ngan gyi blang dor gang yang skye/ /zas dngos snang med khyod la yid ma ches | | da sprang zas dka' las kyis tshol nyan yang med/ /zas kha la gang bab phung po'i gsos/ /zas de kun kyang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ /snang ba dpe cha ru ma shes pas/ /tha snyad kyi mtha' la thug pa med/ /gzhung tshig dang yi ge la yid ma ches/ /da sprang po gzhung bshad byed nyan yang med/ /gdams ngag tshig re tsam snod ldan gyi snod/ /don de kun

( ¡¶ zha ¡· + yang ) phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ / sems 'khor 'das kyi mnga' bdag tu ma shes pas/ /mnga' ris slob 'khor la mngon zhen byas/ /blo phar shor gyi mi la yid ma ches/ /da sprangapo ma thul ba 'dul nyan yang med/ /rjes dran drug po byang chub kyi grogs/ /de kun kyang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ /dbyangs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang drug 'di/ /blo skyo ba'i tshe na blangs pa yin/ /sems gnyen po bsten nas blangs pa yin/ /rje btsun rin po che'i mgur i thi// // ༄༅/ /sems 'dul tshul gyi nyams dbyangs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon shes mig bral bdag ni las mang zhing*/ /ma drangs skye bo'i gcong rong tsher nang du/ /byang chub sems kyi mkhar shing lcug ldem pas/ khro bcas g.yang sa'i nang du lhung du dogs | | sems kyi glang po tshul khrims lcags kyu can/ /dran dang shes bzhin rgyan gyis legs brgyan nas/ /byang chub sems kyi bka' chen ma brtan na/ /nga rgyal myos chus las la bshes kyis dogs/ /yid kyis cang shes thos bsam rgyan can 'di/ /bsgom sems brtson pa'i lcag gis ma bskul na/ /mnga' ris yul gyi ljang bus sems drangs nas/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po'i gnas su ma phyin dogs | | sems kyi ded dpon rgyud don gru gzings can/ /ting 'dzin brtson pa'i ba dan gyis brgyan kyang*/ /gdams ngag zab mo'i rig sngags bsten byas la | | ting 'dzin skyon can klong du 'gro mi bya/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas su gsungs || || ༄༅/ /sgrub pa nyams su len tshul bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo ratna gu ra we/ dal 'byor 'dzom pa'i skal ba can/ /skye 'chis 'jigs pa'i dad pa can/ /gsung bzhin bsgrub pa'i mos gus can/ / bu shes gsal 'di bzhin sems la zhog /sgrub pa nyams su len pa la/ /snying rus sbyang pa che ba dang*/ /zhen log ri la sdod tshugs dang*/ /tshe 'di blo yis thong kyang 'tshal/ /yon tan rgyud la skye ba la/

/sdom gsum dam tshig gtsang ba dang*// nga rgyal rlom sems chung ba dang*/ /thams cad spyi bor khur yang 'tshal/ /rje yi byin rlabs 'jug pa la/ /sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang*/ /rnam thar lag tu len pa dang*/ /rgyun par gsol ba 'debs kyang 'tshal/ /lta ba go yul ma song la/ /snang ba sems su thag chod dang*/ /'khor 'das spang blang med pa dang | | mkhan po dbyings su dag kyang 'tshal/ /sgom pa sems 'dzin ma las la | | bde gsal zhen pa bral ba dang*/ /rtsa chad rang sa zin pa dang*/ /smra bsam yul las 'das kyang 'tshal/ /spyod pa blang dor ma shol la/ /gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol ba dang*/ /chos brgyad mgo bo snyoms pa dang*/ /bzang rtog gnyen po bral yang 'tshal/ /'bras bu phyi dus mi re la/ /rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa dang*/ /mnyam rjes gnyis po 'dres pa dang*/ /bsgrub pa'i zhe 'dod zad kyang 'tshal/ /'gro ba gzhan don byed pa la/ /smon lam 'phen pa zad pa dang*// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel shar ba dang*/ /dmigs med thugs rje 'byangs kyang 'tshal// 'tshal ba brgyad kyi dbyangs chung 'di/ /shes rab gsal la blangs pa lags/ / 'di bzhin don dang ldan par mdzod/ /mi ldan bar du bsgom sran bskyed/ /sa māpta i thi// // ༄༅/ /gsang sngags nang gi nyams len bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma rje/ /theg pa gsum gyis 'gro ba 'dul// ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + bla med theg pas 'gro ba 'dul/ / ) zhabs kyi padmar spyi bos 'dud/ /dam tshig can gyi tshul rdor la/ /gsang sngags nang gi dgongs pa dang*/ /nyams len bsdu na 'di tsam yin/ /mi brjed sems la gsal bar zhu/ /dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma la/ /zhabs tog gsum gyis mnyes pa dang*/ /lus dang srog la ltos med pa'i | | ci gsungs bka' las mi 'da' 'tshal/ /snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang*/ /tha mal 'du shes gtan bral bas/ /yi dam ngo bor gsal ba yi// bskyed pa'i rim pa brtan yang 'tshal/ /dag pa lha yi rnal 'byor la/

/yang dag bden 'dzin zhig pa yi/ /snang stong dbyer med 'ja' 'dra ba'i/ /gnyis su med par rtogs kyang 'tshal/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /zag med bde ba'i mdangs chen de/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dga' bzhi'i don/ /ro mnyam gcig tu 'dres kyang 'tshal/ /snang srid dag pa e yi dbyings/ /wam̐ gyi rnam par cir yang shar/ /shar yang e las 'das pa med/ /zung 'jug blo las 'das kyang 'tshal/ /gtsang sbra'i rtog pa gzhom pa dang*/ /phung po lnga dag rigs lnga'i sku/ /thob phyir dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /mi 'bral rgyun du bsten yang 'tshal/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /theg chen lam gyi ngo bo yin | | kun rdzob byang sems mi zags pa'i/ /dmigs med bde ba rgyas kyang 'tshal | | bde stong dbye ba med pa ste/ /gsang ba sngags kyi ngo bo yin/ /kunda byang sems mi zags pa'i/ /chags bral bde ba rgyas kyang 'tshal/ /chos sku mkha' ltar dag pa ste/ /mthar thug rgyud kyi ngo bo yin/ /don dam byang sems mi zags pa'i/ /mnyam rjes med par bstan kyang 'tshal/ /'dzag med gsum gyi rten 'brel gyis/ /snang dang mi snang dbang bsdus nas/ /phrin las bzhi yi lag len gyis/ /gdul bya smin cing grol kyang 'tshal/ /rnam dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa yi/ /gzhal yas khang dang zhi khro'i tshogs/ /zhing yang dag par ldan pa dang*/ /sku dang ye shes phun tshogs 'tshal/ /i thi/ ༄༅/ /rang la rang gis bskul ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni nyon mongs kyis bzung 'khor ba'i chos la dad/ /smra la rab dga' gzhan gyi skyon brjod dag la brtson/ /bdag gi skyon la mi rtog dman pa dag la 'gran/ /don dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa 'di las ldog par gyis/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams dran la brtson pa dang*/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du rab tu dran bya zhing*/ /so sor thar pa gang thob de la 'bad/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs ni gzung bya'i phyir/

/byang chub sems la rab tu dad par gyis | | dus gsum dag tu yan lag bdun pa dang*/ /phung po gsum pa dag ni gdon par bya/ /nam gyi cha stod cha smad dag la ni/ /mi nyal rnal 'byor dag la brtson par gyis/ /mnyam gzhag dag las langs nas spyod lam ni/ /mdo dang bstan bcos las 'byung bzhin du gyis/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig la 'bad cing | | bla ma dam pa mchod la brtson pa dang*/ /sems can ma lus sems ni bsrung bar gyis/ /tshul min rnam rtog rba rlabs byung ba na/ /gnyen po rab tu skyed la spang bar gyis/ khyod la khyod nyid kyis ni ma bskul na/ /bskul ma 'debs pa gzhan dag ga la 'byung*/ /de ltar khyod la rab tu bskul mod kyi/ / gzhung dang mthun par bsgrub pa rab tu dkon/ /spyod pa 'di las sdom par ma byas na/ /rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras bu thob re skan/ /rang la rang gis bskul ba sbyar ba la/ /'gal ba bla ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ /rang la rang gyis bskul ba zhes bya ba shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so/ / ༄༅/ /nyams dbyangs chen mo bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la sbyor mdzad pa'i | | bla ma lha dang dbyer med bzhugs rnams la/ /lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i mchod pa 'bul | | spros bral ngag gi las 'das yid kyis bstod/ /dus gsum sdig gis mi gos bshags pa byed/ /dmigs med 'jigs dang bral ba'i skyabs su 'gro | | tshad ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ched ) bral dmigs yul spangs pa'i sems bskyed byed/ /de yi chos nyid rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ /bsags pa med pa'i dge rtsa byang chub bsngo/ /snang srid stong pa'i maṇḍal 'di bzhes la/ /skal ldan bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lta ba gtan la 'bebs tsam na/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi stong pa nyid/ /lta kun nyes pa 'byung bar gsungs/ /de phyir lta ba lta rgyu med/

/ shes rab can la lta ba med/ /blo rnon po la tshig las 'das/ /brtson 'grus can la bsgom rgyu med/ /dad pa can la rgyu 'bras med/ /snying rje can la sems can med/ /tshogs bsags pa la sangs rgyas med/ /mtha' bral shes brjod yul las 'das/ /dbu ma sems tsam la sogs pa/ /tshig tu brjod pa spraus pa yin | | yid la sems pa rnam rtog yin/ /rang bzhin brjod med bsam med yin | | ji srid lta ba yod ring la/ /sdug bsngal kun las mi grol te/ /rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed gsungs/ /thos pas shes rgyud ma grol bar/ /lta ba tshig tu ma btang cig / lung dang rigs pa man ngag gis/ /lta ba thag chod blo re bde/ /sgom pa nyams len byed tsam na/ /sgom med sgom pa po yang med/ /yul med mtha' bral sgom pa de/ /bya ba thong la nyams su long*/ /sems med sems kyi sems la ltos/ /mthong rgyu byung na sems nyid min/ /mthong med mthong bas sems nyid mthong*/ /mthong med sems la ma yengs zhog /chags na gsal bas zin par mdzod/ /rgod na dran pa'i lcags kyus zung*/ /gsal la mi rtog sgom pa yin/ /nyams kyi rtsi yis ma zin par/ /sgom pa tshig tu ma btang cig /snying rje sems bskyed sngon du btang | | mjug tu dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /spyod pa nyams su len tsam na/ /lta sgom nyams su myong ba yin/ /snang ba'i dngos po rgyas btab nas/ /blang dor med pa'i spyod pa mdzod/ /ma bcos shugs 'byung spyod pa de/ /tshul 'chos phyogs su ma btang cig /grogs su 'gro ba'i spyod pa de/ /tho co'i phyogs su ma btang cig /'dzin med ro snyoms spyod pa de/ /chags sdang phyogs su ma btang cig | byar med lhug pa'i spyod pa de/ /sdig pa'i phyogs su ma btang cig / 'khor gsum yang dag spyod pa de/ /zag bcas dge bar ma btang cig /dge med sdig med spyod pa de/ /lung ma bstan du ma btang cig

/sangs rgyas gtan la 'bebs tsam na/ /sems las ma gtogs chos rnams med/ /sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas yin/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du ma btsal zhig /chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan de/ /gzhi yi phyogs su mi gtang 'tshal/ /gzugs sku gdul bya'i snang ba la/ /sangs rgyas ngo bor ma 'dzin cig /gzhi la sangs rgyas med pa la/ /thob tu re ba mi bgyid 'tshal/ /don la sems can med pa la/ sdug gi dogs pa mi bgyid 'tshal/ /lta ba bsam brjod med pa la/ /mdo rgyud thos bsam byas pas 'khrul/ /sgom pa mtha' dang bral ba la/ /lus sems rtsol ba byas pas 'khrul/ /spyod pa shugs 'byung 'gag med de/ /tshul 'chos tho cor shor bas 'khrul/ /'bras bu 'khor 'das dbyer med de/ /re dogs phyogs su shor bas 'khrul/ /lta ba dbu ma chen po de/ khas len med de ma 'khrul bde/ / sgom pa lus sems lhug pa de/ /rtsol sgrub med de ma 'khrul bde/ /spyod pa chags sdang rgyu gzhi de/ /blang dor med de ma 'khrul bde/ /'bras bu phyag rgya chen po de/ /re dogs med pas ma 'khrul bde/ /lta ba spros pa med na yin/ / sgom pa yengs pa med na yin/ /spyod pa bya ba thong na yin/ /'bras bu sems nyid rtogs na yin/ /sgro 'dogs chod na lta ba yin/ /yengs pa med na sgom pa yin | | zhen chags med na spyod pa yin/ /yon tan rdzogs na 'bras bu yin/ / lar lta ba rtogs pa'i skyes bu la/ /sgom du ci yang mi gda' na/ /nyams len med pa'i sgom chen de/ /spyod pa spyad rgyu mi gda' na/ /spyod dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /'bras bu ci yang mi gda' na/ /lta ba med pa lta ba'i mchog / grub mtha' 'di la dgos pa med/ /sgom du med pa bsgom pa'i mchog / sems 'dzin 'di la dgos pa med/ /spyod pa med pa spyod pa'i mchog /tshul 'chos 'di la dgos pa med/ /'bras bu med pa 'bras bu'i mchog /re dogs 'di la dgos pa med/ /lar gnas lugs don la mthong rgyu med/

/da ni lta yang mi lta'o/ /gnyug ma 'di la bsgom rgyu med/ /da ni bsgom yang mi bsgom mo | | dbyings kyi ngang la spyod du med/ /da ni spyad kyang mi spyad do/ /lta ba mtha' dbus mi gda' na/ /nam mkha' yin pa ka snyam bgyid/ /sgom la g.yo 'gul mi gda' na/ /ri bo yin pa ka snyam bgyid/ /nyams la gsal 'grib mi gda' na/ /nyi zla yin pa ka snyam bgyid/ /spyod pa blang dor mi gda' na/ /sa gzhi yin pa ka snyam bgyid/ /'bras bu re dogs mi gda' na/ /zhen log yin pa ka snyam bgyid/ /lta thog tu sgom pa khel ma khel/ /lta thog tu sgom pa khel tsam na/ /gnyug ma'i don la yengs ba med/ /sgom thog tu lta ba khel ma khel// sgom thog tu lta ba khel tsam na/ /bsam gtan gyi ro la chags pa med/ /spyod thog tu lta sgom khel ma khel/ /spyod thog tu lta sgom khel tsam na/ /mnyam rjes med pa'i nyams rtogs 'char/ /sems la rtogs pa ma skyes pa'i/ /lta ba mtho bas ci la phan/ /nyon mongs gnyen por ma song bas/ /sgom pa bzang bas ci la phan/ /shes rab snying rjes ma zin pas/ /spyod pa zhib pas ci la phan/ /rang skyon kha yang ma 'bri bas/ /ye sangs rgyas kyis ci la phan/ /skye ba med pa'i don rtogs na/ /lta ba tshad du skyol ba yin/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis med na// sgom pa tshad du skyol ba yin/ /tshar gcad rjes gzung snyoms pa na/ /spyod pa tshad du skyol ba yin/ /chos sku gzugs sku gnyis thob na/ /'bras bu tshad du skyol ba yin/ /lta ba rang gi sems la dris/ /rtag chad 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos | | sgom pa rang gi sems la dris/ /yengs pa 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos// spyod pa rang gi sems la dris/ /tha mal 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /'bras bu rang gi sems la dris/ /dka' thub nus sam mi nus ltos/ /lta ba sems kyi skyel ma yin/ /sgom pa sems kyi 'gro lam yin/ /spyod pa sems kyi grogs po yin | | 'bras bu sems kyi sun ma yin/

/lta ba'i dgung sngon mtho na bzhed/ / sgom pa'i rgya mtsho zab na bzhed/ /spyod pa'i zhing sa gshin na bzhed/ /'bras bu'i lo tog smin na bzhed/ /bdag shes rab can yang ma lags te/ /bla ma mkhas pa bsten pa dang*/ /thos bsam byas pa'i yon tan gyis/ /rtogs pa'i go tshul 'di ltar skyes/ /rgya mtsho'i rus sbal gnya' shing ltar/ /mi lus thob pa dka' bar go /'jog po'i gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /bla ma rnyed par dka' bar go /dus bzhi lus kyi 'gyur ba 'di/ /'chi ba'i bya gtong yin par go / skyes bu dgra yi yul bton bzhin/ /thams cad bzhag nas 'gro bar go /rma bya'i mdongs kyi kha dog bzhin/ /thams cad las las skyes par go /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rtogs na/ /'khor bar skye ba med par go /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang ba'i rang bzhin stong par go /rmi lam ltad mo mthong ba bzhin/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin snang bar go kha chu dwangs pa'i gser bzhin du/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag par go /sprin dang rnyog ma g.ya' bzhin du | | rnam rtog glo bur yin par go /rnam rtog 'khor ba yin par go /rtog med myang 'das yin par go /'khor ba sdug bsngal yin par go

/thar pa bde ba yin par go /bde sdug gnyis su med par go /ye stong ye bral yin par go / lar sems la go rtogs shar na bde/ /lta ba rtogs na yang kyang bde/ /rnam par smin pa'i sgyu lus bde/ /na tsha med na yang kyang bde/ /ri khrod dgon pa brten na bde/ /bya ba btang na yang kyang bde/ /chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba bde | | log 'tsho spangs na yang kyang bde/ /lus sems gzhon pa'i 'dod yon bde | | thabs kyis zin na yang kyang bde/ /lta spyod mthun pa'i grogs po bde// gcig pur sdod pa'i nyams len bde/ /zhen chags med pa'i zas nor bde/ / nges pa med pa'i sdod sa bde/ /ngo srung bral ba'i mthun 'jug bde/ /rang dbang rang gis thob na bde/ /bdag bsod nams can zhig ma lags te/ /mi lus gtsang ma thob pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /mi chos la zhen pa log pa dang*/ /lha chos la spro ba skyes pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /rang yul spangs nas phyin pa dang*/ /byes su bla ma mjal ba gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung | | sde snod la thos pa byas pa dang*/ /tshig don gnyis ka shes pa gnyis/ / de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /sngags kyi bla ma rnyed pa dang*/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /snyan rgyud gdams ngag gnang ba dang*/ /nges shes gting nas skyes pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /rje la mos pa skyes pa dang*/ /byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /phyi yul sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*/ /rang byung ye shes shar ba gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /bskyed rim lha ru gsal ba dang*/ /rdzogs rim nyams su myong ba gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /lus la bde drod 'bar ba dang | | sems la snang stong skyes pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung

| | kun rdzob 'khrul par go ba dang*/ /don dam stong par shes pa gnyis/ / de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /shes pa yul la shor ba dang*/ /dran pa'i lcags kyus zin pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /rkyen ngan jag pa byung ba dang*/ /gnyen po'i ra mda' sleb pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /'dod pa yul la shor ba dang*/ /thabs la mkhas pas zin pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /bde sdug nyams su myong ba dang*/ /de nyid sgyu mar shes pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// sems can sdug bsngal mthong ba dang*/ /snying rje gting nas skyes pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /rgol ba'i klan ka byung ba dang*/ /gtan tshigs khong nas shar ba gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /bsod nams chu mig rdol ba dang/ /zas nor zhen pa log pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /tshul 'chos spyod pa dor ba dang*/ /ci dga'i spyod pa byed pa gnyis/ /de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*/ /thos dang shes rab 'dzom yang 'tshal/ /lung dang rigs par 'dzom yang 'tshal/ /bla ma brgyud par 'dzom yang 'tshal/ /gdams ngag nyams len 'dzom yang 'tshal/ /dad pa brtson 'grus 'dzom yang 'tshal/ /yon tan grags par 'dzom yang 'tshal/ /shes rab med pa'i thos pa des/ /go rtogs skye bar mi gda' na/ /lung gis ma zin rigs pa des/ /nges shes skye bar mi gda' na/ /brgyud pa med pa'i bla ma des || byin rlabs 'byung bar mi gda' na/ /brtson 'grus med pa'i dad pa des | | lag tu lon par mi gda' na/ /nyams len med pa'i gdams ngag des | | rang la phan par mi gda' na/ /grags pa med pa'i yon tan des/ / gzhan la phan par mi gda' na/ /sgong med bya de gang nas byung*/ /bya med sgo nga ci las byung*/ /bya dang sgo nga gang snga'o/ /rang bzhin skye ba med pa la/ /rkyen gyis byed par mi 'jug na/

/rgyu dang 'bras bu gang snga'o/ /sems nyid gdon nas dag pa la/ /rnam rtog ye shes gnyis med na/ /sangs rgyas sems can gang snga'o | | chos rnams ye nas med pa la/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas mi 'byung na/ / chos dang sangs rgyas gang snga'o/ /don la ci yangamed pa la/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul gnyis med na/ /kun rdzob don dam gang snga'o/ /don la sangs rgyas med pa la/ /sde snod gsum po su yis gsungs/ /ston pas chos 'ga' ma gsungs na | | pusti glegs bam ji ltar yin/ /'gag pa dngos med shi ba dang*/ /skye bar 'gyur ba gang thams cad/ /byas pa don med ces gsungs na/ /las las 'bras bu cang 'byung ngam/ /rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /'gag par 'gyur ba ji ltar yin/ /chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i/ /dngos po gang yang yod pa min/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid de/ /skye 'gag yod ( ¡¶ lu ¡· med ) pa ji ltar yin/ /chos rnams thams cad brdzun yin na/ /blo ltos byed pa ji ltar yin/ /chos rnams thams cad bden yin na/ /thams cad bslu ba ji ltar yin/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal nyid yin na/ /sdig pa byed pa shin tu 'khrul// mtho ris thar pa med gsungs na/ /de rgyu dge ba byed pa 'khrul/ /las 'bras bden pa nyid yin na/ /rang bzhin stong pa yin pa 'khrul/ /chu zla nam mkha'i zla ba min/ /de la ma ltos de snang med/ /de bzhin dngos po thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin bden pa gnyis su gsungs/ /bden pa gnyis las ma gtogs pa'i/ / chos de 'thad par mi 'gyur te/ /rang bzhin bden min brdzun min pas/ / bden pa gnyis su 'dzin pa 'khrul/ /'dod yon sred pa'i tshwa chu la/ /ngoms pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /mdze pos me long bltas pa bzhin/ /zhen pa log na ngoms pa lags/ /duḥkha chu bo'i gnyer ma la/ /sangs pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /thabs kyis me bsad du ba bzhin/ /sdig las log na sangs pa yin | | skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo las/ /thar pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/

/chu la zam pa btsugs pa bzhin/ /skye med rtogs na thar pa lags/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ /bskam pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /srid pa'i nyi bdun shar ba bzhin/ /'dod sred log na skam pa yin/ /'dus byas bya ba'i las ka la | | zin pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /chu dag 'ol kha bsgyur ba bzhin/ / cog gis bzhag na zin pa lags/ /gti mug mun pas thibs po la/ /sangs pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /mun khung nang du sgron me bzhin/ /ye shes nyi ma shar na sangs/ /bdag med ye shes nyi ma la/ /'char ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i skya rengs bzhin/ /chos mchog rgyud la skyes na 'char | | rnam rtog nyon mongs zug rngu la/ /'byin pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na | | sman pa mkhas pas mde'u bton bzhin/ /gnyen po stobs dang ldan na 'byin | | bdag 'dzin ser sna'i mdud pa la/ /grol ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na | | dar gyi mdud pa bkrol ba bzhin/ /longs spyod sgyu mar shes na grol/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson dong nas/ /thar pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// btson bu dong nas bton pa bzhin/ /gzung 'dzin lcags sgrog grol na thar/ / mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /phyin pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /'gron po lam du zhugs pa bzhin/ /thar pa'i lam sna zin na phyin/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ /mjal ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /rtag tu ngu dang chos 'phags bzhin/ /sngon sbyangs las 'phro yod na mjal/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun la/ 'thung ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /skom pas btung ba rnyed pa bzhin/ /snod ldan bya ba btang na 'thung*/ /gnyis med phyag rgya chen po la/ / rtogs pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /rnga mo bu dang 'phrad pa bzhin/ /sems ngo shes na rtogs pa lags/ /tha snyad tshig gi lo ma la/ /'dzad pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /ka cha zad pa'i yo lang bzhin/ /rnam rtog zad na 'dzad pa lags// rang rgyud ko ba gyong po la/

/thul ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /chu ser can la klad chu bzhin/ /chos bzhin byed na thul ba lags/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan la | | thob pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i rgyal srid bzhin/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs na thob pa lags/ /thos bsam byas pa'i grwa pa rnams/ /mdo rgyud dgongs pa longs lags sam/ /sgro 'dogs chod pa med nyen che'o/ /tha snyad phyogs su mi btang 'tshal/ /zin bshad mdzad pa'i ston pa kun/ /rang la nges shes bdog lags sam/ /dam pa'i gdams ngag rtsad chod cig/mkhas pa tha mal 'chi nyen gda'o/ /nyams len mdzad pa'i sgom chen kun/ /bre mo'i las la ma dga' mdzod/ /lto rgyab gdung ba ma che mdzod/ / bsam gtan ro la ma chags mdzod/ /sdig las log pa'i chos pa kun/ /mdo rgyud lta rtogs bag re mdzod/ /skabs su bla ma'i phyags phyir 'brang*/ /rtag tu rang gi sems la ltos/ /dge ba'i phyogs la g.yel ba na/ /'chi ba'i 'gyur ba yid la gyis/ /yul la chags sdang skyes pa na/ /chos kyi chos nyid yid la gyis// 'khor dang zang zing 'brel ba na/ /bdud kyi bslu brid shes par gyis/ /ji ltar byas kyang ma bde na/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs yid la gyis/ /chos kyis 'di dang phyi mar bde/ /srid pa bar dor bde ba ste/ /skye ba phyi mar bde ba yin/ / skye ba med pas shin tu bde/ /rang bde gzhan bde gnyis ka bde/ /de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /mi lus gtsang ma thob dus su/ /lha chos mi bgyid ji ltar lags | | bla ma dam pa bsten bsten nas/ /mnyes par mi bgyid ji ltar lags | | gdams ngag zab mo zhu zhu nas/ /nyams su mi len ji ltar lags// chos la nges shes skyes skyes nas/ /slar la ldog pa ji ltar lags/ /lar rang yul spongs la byes su sdod/ /yul dang bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /blo phugs dkar po'i chos la gtod/ /dmyal bar skyes kyang 'gyod pa med/ /yi dam gtso bor bla ma bsten/ /yo byad zad kyang 'gyod pa med/

/bla ma bsnyen bkur gang yin bya/ /thugs mi 'dogs kyanga'agyod pa med/ /lung dang bstun pa'i man ngag zhu | | nyams len ma byung 'gyod pa med/ /dge sbyor gtso bor bya ba thong*/ / dngos grub ma thob 'gyod pa med/ /so nam gtso bor dam tshig srungs/ /grogs kyis khrel yang 'gyod pa med/ /tshogs sogs mi tshe chos la skyol/ /shi bar gyur kyang 'gyod pa med/ /rang re mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod/ /gzhan gyis 'phyas kyang 'gyod pa med/ /grogs la ma dga' gcig pur sdod/ /nad g.yog med kyang 'gyod pa med/ /lta rtogs gtso bor sems la ltos/ /go rtogs chung yang 'gyod pa med/ /nad dang mthun pa'i kha zas bsten/ /na tsha byung yang 'gyod pa med/ / rten dang mthun pa'i spyod pa gyis/ /tshul 'chos song yang 'gyod pa med/ / gzhan skyon ma rtog rang skyon rtog /sha tsha chung yang 'gyod pa med/ /bsam mno'i gtso bor gzhan phan soms/ /rang don shor yang 'gyod pa med/ / nyams dang mthun pa'i glu chung long*/ /tho cor shor yang 'gyod pa med/ /yo lang sris kyi tshod dang sbyor/ /ston mo ngan yang 'gyod pa med/ /rgya mtsho'i nang du rdo bskyur bzhin/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i chos shig 'tshal/ /tā la'i mgo bo bcad pa bzhin | | skye ba med pa'i chos shig 'tshal/ /mun pa'i tshogs la snang ba bzhin || gnyen por 'gro ba'i chos shig 'tshal/ /rig byed bram ze'i slob ma bzhin | | lung gis zin pa'i chos shig 'tshal/ /gser la nag tshur btab pa bzhin | | grogs su 'gro ba'i chos shig 'tshal/ /lha khang nang gi sgo srung de/ / brdeg brdeg 'dra la mi brdeg go /mnga' thang rgyas pa'i khyim pa de/ /skyid skyid 'dra yang sdug pa yin/ /dka' thub byed pa'i chos pa de/ /sdug sdug 'dra yang skyid pa yin/ /sbyin pa btang ba'i longs spyod de/ /'dzad 'dzad 'dra yang 'phel ba yin/ /sangs rgyas sems can mnyam pa la/ /skyid sdug khyad re che zhig byung || bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa la/

/ched 'dzin khyad re che zhig byung*/ / dgra dang bu ru mnyam pa la/ /byams sdang khyad re che zhig byung*/ /mi lus thob par mnyam pa la/ /rgyal pham khyad re che zhig byung*/ /mi lus thob pa'i skyes bu kun | | sdig pa'i las la ma dga' mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i duḥkha mi bzod par/ / ngan song duḥkha smos ci dgos/ /dge ba byed pa thams cad la/ /lta ba bsngo bas zin par mdzod/ /zag bcas dge bar mi gtang 'tshal/ /'khor ba pa la bde ba med/ /rang la de don mi gnas par/ /zhal ta byas pas ci la phan/ /tshe 'di'i 'du shes ma log par/ /chos sgor zhugs pas ci la phan/ /skye shi'i 'jigs pa med pa la/ /gdams ngag bstan pas ci la phan/ /rnam rtog skra lo ma bregs pa'i/ /mgo spu bregs pas ci la phan/ /tha mal 'du shes ma bsgyur bar | | gos mdog bsgyur bas ci la phan/ /bla ma dam pa ma bsten par/ / rang yul spangs pas ci la phan/ /gdams ngag nyams su ma blangs bar/ /thos bsam byas pas ci la phan/ /'chi ba'i dus la babs pa na/ /chos min phan par mi gda'o/ /lar 'dod can bla ma g.yo sgyu can/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag gnang dus med/ /drang don bslu brid brdzun po che/ /nges pa'i don dang mjal dus med/ /'khor ba'i duḥkha tshan po che/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob dus med/ / gti mug mun nag tshabs po che/ /ye shes nyi ma 'char dus med/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i don rtogs na/ /bden tshig rtsad nas chod pa lags/ /skye ba med pa'i don rtogs na/ /'khrul pa rtsad nas chod pa lags/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i don rtogs na | | drang don rtsad nas chod pa lags/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i don rtogs na/ / nges don rtsad nas chod pa lags/ /stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs na/ /rnam rtog rtsad nas chod pa lags/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs zin na/ /gdams ngag rtsad nas chod pa lags/ /ji tsam pa yi chos shes kyang*/ /gdams pa'i snod dang mi ldan na/ /lta ba rtogs par mi gda'o/ /tha snyad spros pa ma chod pa'i/ /'jig rten g.yeng bas ma g.yengs shing*/

/gcig pur sdod cig ma nus na/ /dngos grub thob par mi gda'o/ /'khor dang zang zing spongs la thong*/ /don gyi bcud thigs ma rtogs na/ /tha snyad sbun la snying po med/ /chos brgyad g.yeng bas ma khyer bar/ /bya ba thong la nyams su longs/ /lta ba sgom pa 'brel lam ltos/ / spyod pa dus dang 'brel lam ltos/ /gdams ngag lung dang 'brel lam ltos/ / chos dang gang zag 'brel lam ltos/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob 'brel lam ltos | | bla ma brgyud par 'brel lam ltos/ /lar mdo rgyud tshig la thug pa med | | da ni tshig 'phro gcod las che/ /don la sgro 'dogs chod nas gda'/ / da ni lta 'phro gcod las che/ /'jig rten bya bas dgos pa med/ /da ni g.yeng ba spangs las che/ /'chi bdag gshin rje blo ltos med/ /da ni nyams su len las che/ /nam 'chi cha med brtson 'grus bskyed/ /skyid na bla ma'i bka' drin yin | | sdug na sngon gyi las 'phro yin/ /rgud na zhum par mi bgyid cing*/ / 'byor na dregs par mi bgyid 'tshal/ /chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong las/ /dad pa can gyi gang zag gis/ /sdig las ldog pa de yin mod/

/dge ba'i bya bar 'jug dgos la/ /byar med blo dang ldan dgos kyis/ /chos kyi bya ba'ang zhog la thong*/ /chos la smod pa ma lags te/ /gang zag la yang gshe ma lags/ / chos dang gang zag 'dzol ba mthong*/ /de yang ji ltar mthong zhe na/ /thos chung shes rab zhan pa yis/ /gang zag chos kyis bslus pa mthong*/ /rtogs pa'i don dang mi ldan par/ /chos dang gang zag sgro skur che/ /rnam rtog srin bu'i kha chus gtums/ /nga bzang bdud kyi lcags kyus zin/ /du ma ro gcig gnad dang bral/ /bka' gdams chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /dge sdig blang dor mi phyed pas | | mi shes bzhin du mkhas par brdzu/ /drod med tho co'i spyod pa byed/ /slu byed rgyal khams brdzun gyis 'gengs/ /rnal 'byor chos kyang zhog la thong*/ / gsang sngags chos su khas blangs nas/ /smin lam dbang dang mi ldan zhing*/ / grol lam thabs kyi gnad dang bral/ /gsang sngags rje btsun ma 'jal bas// phyag chen chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /theg chen chos su khas blangs nas/ /snying rje byang chub sems dang bral/ /rtsol med gzhi yi chos su las/ /chos dang gang zag 'brel ba med/ /rdzogs chen chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /phung po gzhi med ri bong rwas/ khyad par kha mig gnyer ma bgrang*/ /mtshan gzhi med par mtshan nyid tshol/ /mngon pa'i chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /'khrul snang dngos med bslu ba la | | don med 'gal 'gal 'brel rtsis byed/ /sems la mi phan 'chi khar bslu | | tshad ma'i chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /'khrul snang bden 'dzin khong skran can | | stong nyid khas len snying por 'dzin/ khyab pa phyogs chos rtsol sgrub can || dbu ma'i chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /tha snyad tshig la mi tshe bskyal/ /mkhas kyang sems kyi don mi shes/ /'chi khar rmongs pa'i lus su 'chi/ /mtshan nyid chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid mi ldan par/ /gsum ldan chos kyis 'brel bar byed/ /'dod chen chos la rin thang 'debs/

/dam med bla ma'i jo mo spyad/ /thabs med sbyor sgrol gnyis la zhen/ /sngags pa'i chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /tshul 'chos lus ngag btson du 'dzin/ /sems nyid lta sgom don dang bral/ /don med dka' thub ngo lkog can/ /btsun pa'i chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /thos bsam ma byas glen sgom byed/ /sdod na tshems drubs mkhar len byed/ /grong du 'gro na tshul 'chos byed/ /thun zhabs bying rmugs gnyid du gtong | | lta na khur gyi 'og tu lta/ khur can mtshams kyi nang du gtong*/ khur med sgo yi phyi ru sdom/ /dad zas nor gyis tsha srin gso/ /sgom chen chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /chos zab bshad na go ba med/ /'brel med long gtam bzhad gad dang*/ /slu byed bro dang glu la dga'/ kha chos kha lta g.yo sgyu can/ /ya ma kha mchu phra ma skyel/ /thob na khyim mtshes nang nor brku/ /byar med khyim so rlung la bskur | | nya ma'i chos kyang zhog la thong*/ khe grags 'thab rtsod 'tsho skyong dang*// tshol khro duḥkha byur gyi tshang*/ /dge ba'i chos la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /don med mi tshe sdug la skyel/ /'gro sa ngan song gsum las med/ khyim pa'i chos kyang zhog la thong*/ /dang po sdig gi bya ba thong*/ /bar du 'jig rten bya ba thong*/ /tha ma chos kyi bya ba'ang thong*/ /bya btang rnal 'byor blo re bde/ /nor sogs sgom chen khyim pa yin/ /mtshan bcas sgom pa rnam rtog yin/ /lus ngag dge sbyor tshul 'chos yin/ /byar med tshogs drug lhug par zhog /chags na lha la chags kyang 'ching | | 'dod na sangs rgyas 'dod kyang 'khrul/ /zhen na chos la zhen kyang bslu | | rig pa dbyings kyi ngang la thim/ /go ba rnams la gdams ngag yin/ / sems stong pa'i nang na rig pa 'phyo/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rang sar grol/ / phyogs ris zhe 'dod ming yang med/ /lta ba thag chod blo re bde/ /sgom med nang na yengs med 'phyo/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /bying rgod gnyis kyi ming yang med/

/sgom pa thag chod blo re bde/ /'gag med nang na shugs 'byung 'phyo | | tshul 'chos mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /blang dor bya ba'i ming yang med// spyod pa thag chod blo re bde/ /skye med ngang nas 'chi med 'phyo/ /re dogs mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /'di dang phyi ma ming yang med/ /'bras bu thag chod blo re bde | | lta ba gza' gtad med pa 'byung*/ /'khrul pa 'jig na 'di yis 'jig | zhe 'dod phyogs ris mi bdog pas/ /gzung 'dzin mi gnod ngo mtshar che | | sgom du ma bcos shugs byung 'byung*/ /lam sa chod na 'di yis chod/ / dmigs pa gtad rgyu mi bdog pas/ /bying rgod mi gnod ngo mtshar che/ /spyod pa 'gag med shugs byung 'byung*/ /zhen pa bzlog na 'di yis bzlog/dgag sgrub 'du shes mi bdog pas/ /blang dor mi gnod ngo mtshar che/ /'bras bu ma btsal lhun grub 'byung*/ /tha snyad chos sku 'di yis thob/ /spangs thob 'du shes mi bdog pas/ /re dogs med pa ngo mtshar che/ /res 'ga' nam mkha'i mthongs na bde/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang la bde/ /res 'ga' rgya mtsho'i gting na bde | | g.yo 'gul med pa'i ngang la bde/ /res 'ga' nyi zla'i steng na bde/ / gsal 'grib med pa'i ngang la bde/ /res 'ga' chu bo'i gzhung na bde/ /rgyun chad med pa'i ngang la bde/ /res 'ga' bla ma'i drung na bde/ /gdams ngag spros pa gcod cing bde/ /res 'ga' ri khrod gnas na bde/ /gcig pur nyams len byed cing bde/ /res 'ga' tshong 'dus dbus na bde/ /snang ba lam du khyer zhing bde/ /res 'ga' rnal 'byor gral na bde/ /nyams myong rtogs pa bsdur zhing bde/ /res 'ga' mdze sprang gseb na bde/ /ro snyoms spyod pa byed cing bde/ /res 'ga' rgyal khams yangs na bde/ /phyogs med gcig ldom byed cing bde/ /rtag tu gnas lugs steng na bde/ /phyogs ris med pa'i ngang la bde/ /dang po gros re legs shig byung*/ /bar du so re bsod cig byung*/

/tha ma blo re bde zhig byung*/ /bya ba btang bas lam sna zin/ /cog ge bsdad pas lam sa chod/ /mgo bo gtums pas rgyang mig gsal/ /sems can dmyal ba'i g.yang sa yang*/ /'og min chos kyi pho brang yin/ /tsha grang gnyis kyi sdug bsngal yang*/ /spros dang bral ba'i chos sku yin/ /phyi pa mu stegs grub mtha' yang*/ /snying po don gyi dbu ma yin/ /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag kyang | | sgyu mas sgyu ma bslu ba yin/ /rang gi rtogs pa nyams myong yang*/ /chu la ri mo bris pa yin/ /lam lnga sa bcu shar ba yang*/ /ri bong rwa gnyer bgrang ba bzhin | | phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /don la med pa'i ming tsam yin | | rigs pas grub pa'i chos nyid kyang*/ /snying po med pa'i chu sdong yin/ / byar med gnas lugs rtogs pa dang*/ /nges shes med pa'i kha lta gnyis/ / 'dra ni 'dra ste nor dogs yod/ /dbang po rgya yan gdams ngag dang*/ /tshogs drug yan par shor ba gnyis/ /'dra ni 'dra ste nor dogs yod/ /zhen log shugs kyi byung ba dang*/ /tho co smyon pa'i spyod pa gnyis/ /'dra ni 'dra ste nor dogs yod/ /re dogs gting nas zad pa dang*/ khong skran can gyi 'dod med gnyis | | 'dra ni 'dra ste nor dogs yod/ /dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis | | nyams myong glu ru blangs pa yin/ /mdo rgyud gnyis la brten pa yin/ / tshig gi sdeb sbyor byas pa yin/ /snyan ngag rgyan gyis spras pa yin/ /mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gcog pa yin/ /dad can spro ba bskyed pa yin/ /zhes mgur du gsungs pa rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti singnghaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'du ba spyi'i rnam gzhag sgron ma gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di la/ rlung mkhris bad kan gyi nad rang rang gi gnas su byung na/ nad rang dbang can gtso bor gyur ba zhes bya ste/ stod ban kan gyi yul/

bar mkhris pa'i yul/ smad rlung gi yul lo/ /de'ang bad kan gyi gnas su/ rlung lta bu byung na/ nad gzhan dbang can zhes bya ste gso dka'o/ /yang stod me yin la/ smad chu yin pas/ tsha grang go log pa dang*/ snying me mkhal ma chu yin te/ nad tsha grang go log pa lta bu'o | | spyir ni 'di ru 'byung mi srid do/ /de'ang nad pags pa la gram pa dang*/ rtsa la zhugs pa dang*/ sha la zhugs pa dang*/ rus pa la zhugs pa dang*/ don snying la zhugs pa dang*/ snod du lhung ba'o/ /de'ang nad kyi rgyu bad kan/ nad kyi rta rlung*/ nad kyi dug mkhris pa yin te/ nad log pa zhes bya ba yang*/ rlung lta bu bcos pas/ de ma zhu bar/ mkhris pa skyes nas/ gcig ma zhi bar gcig skyes nas ldan par song ba/ gang mtho mtho'am gnyan pa nas bcos pa'am/ rlung lta bu zhi nas/ bad kan du log na/ rkyang pa zhes bya ste rang bcos so/ /de'ang snying la nad yod na/ lce skam/ sbrid pa mi thon/ glo ba la nad yod na/ sna 'gags/ glo 'ong*/ mchin pa la nad yod na/ mig dmar la 'tshag g.yal mi shes/ mtsher ba la nad yod na/ mchu smug mkhal ma la nad yod na/ rna bas mi thos so | | de'ang rlung nad yod na/ mig rtsa rgod pa dang*/ mchu 'dar ba dang*/ lce skya la rtsub cing ro mi tshor ba dang*/ so rdeg pa dang*/ rna ba 'ur 'ur/ tig tigakrog krog zer la sgra mi thos pa dang*/ shes pa 'phyo la gnyid mi phebs pa'o/ /tshad pa yod na/ mig dmar ba'am/ ser ba'am/ mchu thung la 'gas pa dang*/ lce ser ba'am | nag la thung ba dang*/ so la dreg pa chags pa dang*/ shes pa byings la gnyid che ba'am/ kha'i rngab grang la rid pa ni bad kan gyi nad yod pa'o//rlung gi nad kha zas dus su ma zos pa dang*/ gnyid chag pa dang*/ ga chad pa dang*/ sems gdungs pa dang*/ mya ngan dang sems las ches pa dang*/ 'khru skyug drag po dang*/ gtar ga drag po'i rjes la na ba ni rlung nad yin te/ lus rtsub la ba spu ldang*/ brang la gzer 'ong*/ mgo 'thoms/

tshigs bye ba snyam byed/ brla dang | tshigs pa dang*/ rked pa dang*/ mgul na/ zug gzer che/ mig rtsa rgod la lag pas bya byed mang*/ smra dka' la lce mchu 'dar/ 'brel ba med pa'i gtam mang*/ shes pa rngam/ khong pa 'ur/ chu dkar/ 'khru na lbu ba sgra dang bcas pa 'byung*/ de rnams gang byung yang*/ rlung gi rtags yin pas/ sha rnying dang*/ mar rnying dang*/ rus rnying sna tshogs gdus pa'i khu ba dang*/ chang nar phyin pa blud la mal chas byibs/ sman mar gtang*/ rlung gsang bsreg go /rlung kha thal ba dang | rlung nad mi bzod pa la/ sgog skya'i sman mar gtang ngo*/ /rlung nad kyi rigs la du ma smos kyang*/ lag tu blangs pa de las med/ mkhris pa bcos pa ni | sgos bcos na gsal lo/ /bad kan la rigs du ma smos kyang*/ skya bo/ smug por 'dus te/ bad kan smug po ma gtogs pa thams cad grang bar gtogs te/ bad kan mchin pa la babs na/ khong tsha/ mig rus na/ byin pa na | lus po lci'o/ /bad kan smug po mkhris pa la rgyas na/ khrag skyug sna khrag 'dzag go /bad kan glo ba la babs na/ ro stod gzer la tshigs pa rengs pa dang | khrag nag po skyug go /bad kan smug po pho ba la babs na/ brang tsha la pho ba na/ khrag btsos pa 'dra ba skyug go /de rnams su bad kan skya bo babs na/ pho mchin gang yin cha med par na/ kha nas chu 'ong*/ zas mi zhim par 'khru skyug byed | khong du lhung na khong pa sbo la 'khrog khong dbugs 'byin zhing phus 'debs/ mtsher ba la babs na/ gnyid che la sgyid pa skyur/ dbugs rgod la drag tu 'khru/ rked pa la babs na chu sri/ dpyi rked na/ drag tu 'khru/ spyir bad kan la ma nu bzhi thang gtang*/ sga'i thang gtang/ rgyam tshwa gsum pa'i thang gtang*/ gzhan yang ro tsha ba'i thang thams cad phan/ thang bskol thang dang chu skol phan no || nas chang la bu ram btab la gtang*/ kha zas drod la bsten/ bshal dang skyug bya/ thams cad la gang la babs pa'i gsang bsreg cong zhi'i sbyor ba zab mo bsten/

'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga pa'i sman mar kun la shis/ man ngag la mdun gyi lhen sna bsreg go /bad kan gyi lag len dril ba de las med do/ / snying gi nad tsha ba las gyur pa la/ ga bur dang bzang drug gtang*/ snying rtsa gtar | snying la grang rlung zhugs pa la/ snying dkar nag gi mtshams dang*/ tshigs pa bdun pa dang ltag pa'i sdud khung bsreg go/zho sha gsum gyi sman mar gtang | zas sha dang chang drod la bsten no/ /glo ba'i nad tsha ba las gyur pa la/ ba le ka dang*/ tig ta'i thang gtang*/ bshal gtang*/ glo rtsa gtar/ tsha ba bri nas bya rog dmigs bsreg go /glo skya rbab grang ba bya ba phyogs gcig pa gcig yin te/ nyin mtshan med par lu/ lud pa la rnag gam/ res 'ga' dmar tshig ge ba 'ong*/ kha gdong skrangs*/ kha rul bro/ /bya rog dmigs gnyis bsreg star bu'i sman mar gtang*/ sha sar dang sings po gtang*/ des bde na chang dang yib sha gtang*/ spyir li ga dur dang gla sgang gang rung tsha grang gi bye brag gis bu ram mam ka ra sbyar nas btang na cis kyang thub pa yin te mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /mchin pa'i nad kyi gzhi ni/ du ma zhig smos kyang*/ gzhi ni sha chang la sogs pa'i kha zas bcud can bza' ba drags pa dang*/ ngal dub drags pa dang | 'du ba cha ma snyoms pa las 'byung ste/ lus skrangs pa dang*/ skra dang smin ma za/ lus skya bam bam du 'ong*/ lce dang rnyil dkar/ ci zos kyang mchin pa na chong chong byed/ g.yal mi thon/ sgur na skad ngan 'ong*/ skom dad che/ ci zos kyang mchin pa la gnod do/ /de la gi wang dang gur gum gyi thang bshal gtang*/ ru thung dang mchin mkhris kyi 'dom rtsa gtar/ mchin pa glang sgur zhes bya ba skrangs shing byad za ba de gtar du mi rung*/ mchin pa'i gsang bsreg brag zhun gyi sman mar gtang ngo*/ /nad choms nas tshigs pa dgu pa bsregs pas nad mi skye'o | | mchin pa la skran yod na/ yod pa ngos la mi phebs/ glo byung na rtsib logs na thang thang byed/

kha kha'o/ /de la gar na ba'i sar me btsa' a na tshugs su gdab bo/ /pho ba'i nad kyi gzhi ni/ ngal dub dang*/ rlan dang ma zhu ba las 'byung*/ glang thabs dang gzer ba la long rtsa gtar/ chu skol gtang*/ glang thabs phyis ye mi ldang bar 'dod na/ lte ba nas phyogs bzhir mtshon re bcal bar me btsa' gdab/ des thub bo/ /pho ba snyong bu dang rgud pa zhes bya ste/ grang rlung las gyur pa la/ tsha ba'i ril bu dang*/ sha chang dang*/ rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar gtang | gos dro bar bya'o/ /mkhal ma bcos pa sgos bcos na gsal/ long nad ni bad kan gyis grang ba bslang ba'i rigs/ khong pa lci zhing 'khrog khong dbugs dang bshus 'debs/ de la bya ril bra ril la sogs pa'i dugs bya/ long gsang bsreg bshul sha gtang*/ rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar gtang ngo*/ /long nad tsha ba la/ ba le ka dang*/ a ru ra'i thang gtang*/ mchin pa rlon pa gtang*/ long rtsa gtar/ bsam se'u la yang*/ nad tsha grang gnyis las grang ba ni/ chu ser dang bad kan las gyur te/ khong pa sbo/ sgregs pa 'ong zhing zos pa mi 'ju/ de la snod du rdo bsros pa'i dugs bya/ lte ba nas mar mtshon gang bcal bar kha gsum du bsreg

gar po gsar pa la bu ram btab la gtang*/ sman mar gtang | gro dang ri dwags kyi sha spang*/ gtar ga mi bya'o/ /bsam se'u'i tsha ba ni | snod bzhir tsha breng breng byas nas stobs chung*/ de la dong ga'i bshal gtang | lug sha gtang*/ de la gtar sreg spang ngo*/ /mtsher nad ni rlung dang grang gzhi las 'byung*/ khong pa sbau/ kha sha lhod/ g.yon gyi rtse'u thung gi bar na mi bzod | de la mcher rtsa gtar/ steng du kha gsum du bsreg go /lums bya'o/ khonga'akhrog cing phyi sa mi thub na/ de la yang kha gsum du bsreg go /me tog sna tshogs pa dang drod kyi lums bya'o/ /ma zhu ba la dwangs ma ma zhu ba dang*/ snyigs ma ma zhu ba gnyis las/ bcos pa mthun te/ chu skol gtang*/ rgyam tshwa gsum pa'i thang gtang*/ drod bshal btang*/ zho skol dang chang bskol gtang*/ spyir ma zhu ba thams cad la/ pho ba'i gsang bsreg 'khru ba'i gzhi ni/ ma zhu ba dang*/ mkhris pa bsdongs na tsha 'khru yin te/ tho rangs kyi chu grang blud/ ma zhu ba bad kan dang bsdongs na grang 'khru yin te/ drod 'ba' zhig gis bcos/ spyir khrag dang | dud khu lta bu dang/ sha khu lta bu'i 'khru ba thams cad mchin pa nas 'byung ba yin no/ /grum bu la bong bu dre'u thang gi khrag dron mo phul gang la gla rtsi dang sga btab la gtang*/ dugs dang lums bya/ bshul sha sna tshogs gtang*/ chang spang | gtar sreg byar mi rung ngo*/ kha zas la nad ngos gzung ba ni/ nangs nub zas zos ma thag na na/ gang na yang bad kan yin te/ brang rgyab tsha la stong sgregs 'ong*/ rke dang pho kha gdengs shing na/ zas mi 'ju/ de la skyugs btang ngo | | zas 'ju ba'i bar la na na/ mkhris pa'i nad yin te/ lus lci/ mgo bo 'khor | mig rib/ mun dub dang chu dub ldang*/ ro stod gzer zhing dbugs mi bde | de la bshal gtang ngo*/ /zas zhu ba'i rjes la na ba ni/ rlung gi nad yin te | glo snying mi bde/ rna ba zug cing na/ gnyid mi phebs/ khong lci/ kha nas chu 'dzag

kha zas zos na phan pa snyam byed/ drod bshal bya/ chang dang bcud gtang | rlung gsang bsreg go /ma zhu ba ni zas gang ma zhu ba de rang zos na khyad par du na'o/ /phye ma zhes bya ba sman gang dgos so so'i tshad dang ldan par byas la | bungs che bar bya/ de rtsi bzhin du btags la/ ga'u gtsang mar blugs la gtang | khrag mkhris can la chu grang gi bsil sman dbul/ bad kan la chu skol lam chang gis dbul/ glo ba la shing mngar gyi khu bas dbul lo/ kha chus mi bshal | kha ras kyis phyi'o/ /de nas mal chas byibs/ rngul ba'am 'dar phril gyis byung na tshugs pa yin no/ /ril bu zhes bya ba/ sman gang sbyor yang snga ma bzhin btags la mgo sdud dang gnyis sprus la mur ro/ /lde gu zhes bya ba/ sman gang sbyor yang snga ma bzhin btags la lde gu'i grogs mar la sogs pa dul la ma tshigs par byas la 'khyags su cha ba la sbyar ro/ khu ba zhes bya ba ni/ rus pa dang sman bskol ba'i thang yin no/ /de yang sman bungs che chung gis chu ran par byas la/ chu sum gnyis sum cha lus tsam du btsags la grang dro ran pa la gtang*/ grang thang ni khram khrum brdungs la khu ba thon pa bgrungs te btsags la gtang ngo*/ /sman mar zhes bya ba ni/ chu skyon bzhis ma gos pa/ ba tshwa med pa/ ma rul ba/ bskol grang du ma song ba/ khron pa'i chu ma yin pa la sbyor ba'i sman rnams btsos la/ khu ba lan gsum gdon/ de dang 'o ma dang*/ 'bri mar rnams gdus la/ chu chod drags na/ sman 'tshig ma chod na 'ju dka' bas/ ran pa'i tshad ni/ thab tu gtigs pas sob mi zer bar me 'bar/ tshigs ma dril du btub pa dang*/ mdzub mos tshugs na chu chod pa yin no/ /sbyor ba de ni 'o mas sna ring bar byed/ chus khong tshos par byed/ mar gyis bcud len par byed/ mngar gyis snyoms par byed/ dkrugs pas 'ju sla bar byed do/ /'khyags su nye tsam na kha tshar rnams btab la chod par dkrugs/ de nas lug thang tsher gyi ser ba rus tsam re gtang*/

rjes la chu mi btung*/ grang du mi gzhug spyod lam gnod pa gzhan yang bsrung ngo*/ /des grang rlung las gyur pa'i nad dang*/ khyad par du mig nad sel lo/ /bshal dang*/ skyug dang*/ 'jam rtsi dang*/ ni ru ha dang | sna bshal rnams ni/ las lnga zhes bya ba yin no/ /dpyad lnga zhes bya ba/ rlung la yos dugs can/ 'ba' cha/ rus pa snum rnams dkris la/ nyin mo dugs byas la/ mtshan mo dgrol/ mtshan mo byas na nyin mo dgrol lo/ /tshad pa gsar pa dang*/ gam 'khrugs gsar pa thams cad la/ chu yi nang du zhugs pa dang | grang dugs phan no/ /tsha ba glang thabs la/ chab bran dang*/ grod pa chus bkang ba'i dugs bya/ grang ba'i nad la tsha lto dang*/ bsku mnye dang*/ so phag gi dugs bya'o/ /lums zhes bya ba sman gyi nus pa ba spur song bas/ nang gi nad thams cad 'joms pa yin te/ rlon zhing khu ba yod pa zhig dgos so/ /lums zin nas dal bus mnye'o/ /lums legs na khong dro/ lus 'jam/ na tsha med par 'gyur ro/ /me btsa' ni me'i drod kyis khrag dang rlung dros pas zhi ba yin no | | gtar ga ni nad sgo ru 'byin pa'o/ /grang ba la gtar na mchin khrag pho bar lhung nas grang ba la byas te de'i rtags ni/ pho ba gzer gyis gang ba dang*/ bsdams te na/ skom dad che/ dgye dgu mi shes/ pho ba grims la tsha lam lam byed | ldang dub 'ong*/ ske bkug nas gsus pa la blta mi shes/ zas yi gar mi 'ong*/ yang khrag lam chad pa'i tsha ba ni/ gtar ga drags pas tsha ba ma zhi bar khrag zad de/ rtsa nang gi rgyu ba chad pa yin no/ /de'i rtags ni/ lus mdangs nyams/ gang na cha med par lus thams cad khyab par na/ dbugs rgod do/ /de rtsa sbubs stong pa zhes bya ba'i nad yin te/ gtar mi rung/ zas yang la bcud yod pa dang*/ sman bsil sman gtang ngo*/ /grang yang mi bsreg pa ni | nad grang ba yin yang gnyid che la khong lci/ dran pa mi gsal/ pho ba ltem/ mchin dri kha skor dang*/ ro stod gzer/ mgo bo na la gdong pa snum pa la bsreg tu mi 'dod do/

/bzang khrag dbyung ba ni/ ngal dub dang drag shul byas nas/ chang ngam chu 'thungs pas/ glo ba'i rtsa sbubs su song bas na/ glo chu shor zhes bya'o | | de'i rtags su glo lu/ rngul kha snyi/ glo snying mi bde la dbugs rgod/ de la bzang drug dang*/ ba le ka dang*/ tsan dan dkar dmar dang*/ se 'bru dang*/ shing mngar rnams ka ra la sbyar la gtang*/ rtse'u chung gnyis gtar ro/ /mchin pa chu shor ni/ sa rlon nam/ grang sar nyal bas/ mchin pa zhu 'khyags su song bas | lus lci/ ldang dub tu na/ pho stod lci/ skabs su 'khru'o/ /de la ru thung gtar | mchin pa'i khrag bshal gtang ngo*/ /mcher pa chu shor ni/ khong pa sbo zhing 'khrog stong sgregs 'ong*/ de la rgya tshwa dang*/ tsha la mar la brdzis pa gtang*/ bshal bya/ pho mcher gyi gsang bsreg go /mkhal ma chu shor ni/ mkhal ma'i drod 'chor/ mkhal rked man chad sbrid cing na/ de la long rtsa dang byin gzhug gtar | rkang mthil rdo tshan gyi dugs bya/ 'bras bu gsum gyi sman gtang*/ mkhal ma'i gsang bsreg de rnams smin du gzhug mi dgos te/ myur du gtar bas chog go /chu la brtag pa ni/ mi rgan po'i chu ni sbu ba dkar po 'ong*/ dar ma'i chu ni ser la dwangs par 'ong*/ byis pa'i chu ni sngo skya dwangs par 'ong*/ nad tsha ba yin yang ja dang*/ dar ba dang/ sings po mang po 'thungs na skya bor 'ong*/ nad grang ba yin yang*/ ngal dub drag po dang*/ me dang nyi mas bsros pa dang*/ skom pas yun ring du ma 'thung na dmar ser du 'ong*/ lta ba'i thabs ni/ snod mi gtsang bar mi blta/ skom bag med 'thung na mi blta/ rlangs pa yal nas mi blta | nad kyi bye brag gi dmigs bsal bstan pa ni/ rlung nad kyi chu dkar ba dang | ku ya dmar skya ba dang*/ grang zhing rlangs pa che ba dang*/ 'ong ba mi tshor ba dang | zas ngan pa zos pa dang*/ grang na chu kha snyi ba'o/ /tshad pa'i chu ni/ ser ba dang*/ dmar ba dang*/ dud ka dang*/ sngo ljang dang*/ reg na tsha ba dang*/ ku ya che ba dang*/

tshigs ma gnag pa'am/ kham par 'ong ba'o/ /snag tsha'am dud khu 'dra ba byung na/ tsha ba rul ba yin pas 'chi'o/ /grang ba'i chu ni/ rlung dang 'dra ba las/ rlangs pa chung la reg na mi tsha ba'o/ kha dog ji ltar byung yang*/ za khur 'dzag na mkhal ma la rde'u yod do/ /rgyas par gzhan du blta'o/ /da ni zas bcos bstan par bya ste/ mkhris pa la bshul sha mtha' dag dang*/ sgog pa'i rigs thams cad/ za dang sne'u la sogs pa sngo ngad thams cad dang*/ sha rnying mar rnying thams cad spang bar bya'o/ /skam sha dang*/ sha ba dang*/ gnyan sha dang*/ khur tshod dang*/ g.yer ma dang*/ go snyod/ ba ra'i mar gsar pa rnams bsten no | | bad kan smug po la/ bshul sha mtha' dag spang*/ rgod g.yag gi sha mchog tu bsngags/ rnga bran sha yang mi sto/ sran ma'i tshod mas phan/ ri dwags kyi sha thams cad mi sto/ lo bshur dang*/ yos dang*/ yos chang spang ngo*/ bad kan skya bo la/ snum khur dang*/ gro chang dang gro yos/ bsil sha ra sha rul sungs | sran ma/ g.yer ma/ go snyod/ skyur po/ lo bshur/ sha rul/ mar rnying spang ngo*/ /bsten pa la rgod g.yag gi sha drod sha nas chang*/ btsong sgog kyang mi sto'o/ /rlung la drod sha dang*/ bu ram dang*/ chang dang*/ sgog pa dang*/ lga dang*/ shing kun dang*/ bshul sha dang*/ snum la lci ba rnams bsten no/ /bsku mnye bya'o | | spang ba ni bsil sha thams cad dang*/ g.yer ma/ go snyod dang*/ srod tho rangs kyi 'gro 'dug dang*/ ra sha dang*/ yungs thug dang*/ lus la grang ba rnams spang ngo*/ /snyoms pa'i zas bcos ni/ gla ba/ dgo ba/ gna' ba'i sha rnams snyoms pa yin no/ /byang khog stod du mtshon phog pa la/ bsil sha dang*/ bsil ba'i zas mtha' dag bsten/ drod kyi sha dang*/ zas mtha' dag spang ngo*// glo nad can la rnga bran gyi sha dang*/ g.yung dang*/ gro chang mchog tu bsngags so/ / nas chang gsar 'jam mi sto/ shing kun dang*/ g.yer ma dang*/ drod sha dang*/ bshul sha mtha' dag spang*/ chang*/ lga/ tsha skyur dang*/ sha rul dang*/ phye srungs dang drag shul mtha' dag spang*/

dud pa la mi sdod/ 'grams kyi glo la gtar ga bsngags | skam glo thangs po la gtar ga bsngags so/ /dmu chu'i zas bcos la | tsha chu grang chu gnyis las/ chu mdog dmar por 'ong na/ tsha chu yin pas bsil gyi sha dang*/ zas bsil ba bsten/ grang chu la ba mar gsar pa dang*/ rgod sha la sogs pa drod sha dang*/ drod kyi kha zas bsten/ bsil sha dang*/ bsil zas mtha' dag spang*/ srin nad la ra sha dang*/ skam sha spel la gtang ngo | | 'bras gso ba la 'bras kyi 'byung sa ngan pa ni/ byin dkyil dang*/ mjing ba g.yas g.yon dang*/ chu ba mang sa dang*/ sna'i krung krung la byung na gso dka'o | | sog pa dkar po la byung na gso ru mi btub bo/ /byung sa bzang ba ni/ 'gram rus/ brang rus/ rtsib ma'i mgo rnams so/ /de la ba bla dang*/ ldong ros/ mu zi/ mtshal/ gu gul nag po rnams byis pa'i chus sbyangs la byug steng du shog spyin glan/ zhag gnyis nas bltas pas sngar ltar ma 'gyur bar 'dug na 'bras yin/ 'gyur na skrang 'bur gzhan yin no/ kham sa rus len la/ gser | mu zi/ g.yer ma/ sbrang rgod byis pa'i chus sbrus la/ par bu'i nang du blugs la/ kha shog bus bcad/ 'dag pa la me gtang*/ de'i steng du sa sor bzhis dgab/ de'i steng du lci me sum yar du gtang*/ de nas sman de bkrus pas | rus pa'i skyon 'gog go /gsod dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ 'du ba spyi'i rnam gzhag sgron ma gsal ba zhes bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so/ /'du ba la brgya smos stong smos kyang*/ dril nas lag tu len pa la de las med pa yin gsung ngo*/ /man ngag 'dril ma shes na/ bya spu rlung gis gtor ba dang 'dra'o/ / bla ma rje btsun pa'i gdams pa'o/ /sa māpta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang khog chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i gdams ngag 'di la gnyis te/ mchin dri yan chad byang khog stod yin la/ man chad byang khog smad yin no/

/stod la mda' dang mtshon phog na/ rdol ma rdol gyi phug 'tshol gtang mi rung ngo*/ /mtshon phyung ma thag tshil bus khrag 'chad do/ /de la phug 'tshol btang na/ khrag dang chu ser nang du 'chor ro/ /de yang glo ba'i ma la phog ma thag chang gsar pa dang dom mkhris sbyar la gtang*/ gtar ga mas 'dzag tu bya/ rtse'u chung kha dbye'o/ /rgyab tu phog na glo ba'i zur rtsa gdab/ mdun du phog na glo ba'i a so gdab bo/ /snying la phog na 'phral la 'chi/ 'phral du ma shi na snying brdungs nas brgyal ba yin pas/ bud med nu zho dron mo khar blugs la rna bar kus gdab/ snying gar chu lcag brdeg brgyal ba sangs pa dang*/ tsandan dang*/ snying zho sha dang*/ gla gor zho sha dang*/ dzā ti dang*/ a ru ra rnams btags la chu grang dang sbyar la ltor gtang*/ snying dkar nag gi mtshams su me btsas bsreg rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis kyi gzhung dang*/ rkang mthil gyi gnyer ma ring po rnams bsreg go /zas bcos snying sna tshogs gtang ngo*/ /mchin pa'i dpyad la/ mchin dri dkar po la phog na skad ngan 'ong*/ mig bar snang du blta/ rkang pa g.yob cing sa la brdeg lag pa g.yob cing brang brdung*/ mi sbo bar sgregs pa 'ong | mig btsums snying 'dod/ 'o dod 'bod pa'i tshul bstan/ tshigs pa brgyad pa bsreg dom mkhris dang ra'i 'o ma sbyar la gtang*/ phyi nan la rta khrag dang | lgang pa dang*/ bag phye sbyar la bya/ go snyod dang*/ g.yer ma'i skam nan bya/ zas bsil drod khre'ur gtang*/ bud med kyis g.yog mi bya/ des thub bo/ / mchin dri nag po la phog nas rtsa chod na khrag nag po gcig 'ong*/ mgo lci/ mig 'dzums thag ring*/ mchin rtsa ma chod na/ khrag dmar po 'ong*/ rtse'u chung bsnol la gdab/ sgyid khung pa'i dkyil du bsreg chu 'gag srid pas chu sman gtang | skabs su bu ram dang*/ sings po sbrags la gtang*/ spyi gtsug dang rkang mthil du bsku mnye bya/ mchin pa'i dpyad la/ mchin pa la brgyab na de ma thag tu 'chi/
