mchin pa brdungs na mig dmar por 'gro bas/ de la mchin pa khrag gi mtsho yin pas rtsa sgo bzhi po gtar/ tshigs pa dgu pa dang*/ bcu pa dang | mtshog ma'i gsang bsregs/ bzang drug gtang*/ ba zho dang*/ ra 'o bskol ba gtang*/ skabs su sha gsar gyi tsho khu gtang*/ sha ba/ gla ba la sogs pa che phyugs sna tshogs pa'i mchin pa gtang*/ 'jam dugs bya'o/ /mtsher pa bcos pa'i thabs la/ mtsher pa'i dbyibs ni khur leb dang 'dra ste/ kha chag la phog na 'chi/ de'i rtags la snying 'dar la lus sbrid/ pho ba spo/ rtsa 'gag kha 'dzums mi shes te bcos su med do/ /mtsher ba'i srab mo la phog na drag tu sbau | rkang lag g.yob/ nye 'khor la blta zhing 'chi bas 'jigs pas/ bcos pa shin tu dka' ste/ mtsher rtsa gtar/ go snyod kyi thang gtang*/ tshigs pa bcu gcig pa'i gsang bsreg lug gi tshil bu dang*/ yos dugs bya/ mod la zas drod la dbab bo/ /pho ba bcos pa'i thabs la/ pho ba la dkyus su mtshon phog na 'chi/

'phred la phog na 'tsho/ pho ba rdol na mi spo la btsan na sbo/ /zhag gsum du lto dgug ru thung gtar/ bu ram dang ka ra sbyar la 'jam bshal du gtang | spyir na pho ba drod kyis bcos te/ lug sha gsar pa gtang*/ rma rtsi drod can 'o ma dang sbyar la gtang*/ thang gtang du mi rung*/ srog pa rtsa la phog na/ bcos pa'i thabs med/ srog pa rtsa bzher bas nyen pa'i rtags ni/ sug bzhi rengs nas lag pas sa la 'brad/ kha ru sa 'debs pa'i tshul ston te/ bcos thabs ni tshigs pa drug pa kha gsum du bsreg yob chen gong 'og gnyis dang*/ sgyid khung gnyis bsreg snying zho sha dang*/ a ru ra/ pha 'ong gi dreg pa sngon po dang | ka ra/ li shi 'o ma la sbyar la gtang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ sgo nga'i ser thig brag zhun rnams/ glang dang*/ ra'i lci ba la sbyar la/ tshigs pa'i gzhung du nan bya | des thub bo/ /mkhal ma'i dpyad la/ mkhal ma rang la phog na/ nyen chung ste | de'i gseb kyi rtsa la phog na 'chi/ ri bong gi ril ma'i dugs bya ste/ mkhal tshig ha cang drod du mi gzhug zhu na 'chi/ 'khyags na yang bab nas 'drul lo/ /rtsa nyams/ mig bzlog chu 'gag dbugs sdom/ rkang pa'i rting pa la 'dzugs snying 'dod/ rna bas mi thos so/ /de la yob chen gong 'og gi rtsa gtar | tshigs pa dgu pa dang bco lnga pa'i gsang bsreg lug gi tshil bu dang slo'i lums bya/ des kyang ma bde na/ rta tshon po'i ze rngog bregs la chang gar ma'i gseb tu btso/ drod ran par byas la/ mkhal ma g.yas g.yon la glan/ de'i steng nas spang ma skam po'i dugs bya/ mkhal ma chu'i khams yin pas/ myur du zas drod la dbab/ mdun nas dugs mi bya'o/ /rgyu ma bcos pa'i thabs la/ mi'i rgyu ma thun gsum du yod de/ 'phred gtubs su song na 'chi/ dkyus su song na mi 'chi ste/ rgyu ma la phog pa'i rtags/ 'dug mi tshugs/ pho ba sbo | pho mtshan la yang yang 'ju/ 'phongs su mdzub bu 'dzud/ 'phongs nas khrag cung zad yong ngo*/

/de la bshal gtang du mi rung*/ khong du dom mkhris gtang | rgyab na dugs mi drag pa bya/ sbang ma'i gar po la bu ram btab la gtang | 'o ma la mkhris chen btab la gtang*/ des thub bo/ /long bcos pa la long gi smad la song na 'chi/ sbo ru yang yang 'ong*/ 'jam bshal bag gcig gtang | lan gsum bzhi bshal ba'i rjes la/ lug sha gsar pa'i tsho khu khyor re tsam sum yar du gtang*/ sman rjes zhag gsum tsam bsrung*/ tsha ba skyes kyang thang gtang du mi rung*/ long rtsa dang yob chen gong 'og gtar ro/ /gnye ma bcos pa la/ gnye ma la phog na 'chi nyen yod pas/ rtags ni long nas skad ngan 'don/ kha nas srin bu dmar po skyug bcos thabs zhag gsum du skam bsri | mar gsar pa gtang*/ zas drod la dbab/ des thub bo/ /byang khog gi gso thabs khyad par can bstan zin to/ /snying rtsa stod ni gser las byas te mnyen | smad ni lcags las byas te gyong*/ stod la snying rtsa gcig yod de/ snying rtsa gser gyi srog rten bya ba ol gong dang mid pa'i bar na yar rta rnga tsam zhig yod de/ de chod na zas mi 'dod/ skom dad che/ zhag gsum mam bzhi nas 'dar du byung na zhag bdun nas nges par 'chi'o/ /snying rtsa gser gyi thang shing gnyis ni/ nu ma nas nang du mtshon gang bcal ba na brang gi gzhung rus gru bzhi nang na yar la thang la khab btud pa bzhin yod do/ /snying rtsa gser gyi mtsho mo zhes bya ba gnyis ni/ gru mo'i nang khug na yod do/ /snying rtsa gser gyi zam pa zhes bya ba gnyis ni/ blta rtsa gnyis yin te/ de chod na mdangs 'chor/ mig gyen la bzlog snying ga'i rtsa thams cad ni 'phar mi nus te/ de bcos pa'i thabs ni/ rtsa'i yar sna mar sna bsreg rtse chung gtar/ tsandan dkar po gtang*/ ga pur gsum pa gtang*/ snying zho sha dang dom mkhris gtang*/ zhag brgyad dang dgu la khrag gis ma bor na gso ru 'dod/ snying rtsa 'khyam bu gnyis mkhrig ma'i zur chu ba dang rgyus pa'i bar na rgyu ste/

chod na khrag gis bor te 'dar zhing skrangs | mchan 'og 'phar rtsa bsreg snying rtsa gser gyi 'bur bu bya ba gnyis mtheb mdzub bar na yod do/ /smad la snying rtsa brgyad yod de/ snying rtsa lcags kyi sran ma zhes bya ba gnyis ni/ glo bu'i nang gi 'gul rtsa yin te/ de chod na rtsa 'phar | khrag mi thub/ byin pa'i nang yul long bu'i sor drug gong du bsreg gtar sreg gzhan tshod dang sbyar/ bcos pa nyes na ma shi yang theng por 'gro'o// snying rtsa lcags kyi khyi mo zhes bya ba gnyis ni/ yob chen gyi gong na sram rtse la 'khyud nas/ khyi nyal ba ltar gnas pas/ de chod na 'phral du 'chi'o/ /snying rtsa lcags kyi ka ba zhes bya ba gnyis ni/ pus mo'i mar sna nas mar chag gang bcal ba na yod/ de chod na rmen bu'i rtags 'byung*/ rlab rdol 'ong*/ de la na sar rmen bu bsregs pas thub bo/ /snying rtsa lcags kyi mchog ma gnyis ni sgeb khung na yod de/ de chod na lag pa sbrid la 'degs mi shes/ gdong par khrag 'phung | mur gong gi 'phar rtsa chad na rtsa de rnams myur du gtar ro/ /glo rtsa gnyan po bstan pa ni/ dpung ba'i zur nas mchan khung du chag gang bcal ba na yod | glo rtsa khug pa bya ba yod de/ de chod pa'i rtags skad ngan 'jam la zas mi 'dod | mig ser la tsha ba ste/ gnyid che/ zur gzer che/ glo ba'i sbubs su rnag dang chu ser 'chor ba'i rtsa yin pas/ de la tig ta dang*/ par pa ta dang*/ ba sha ka'i thang gtang ngo*/ /glo rtsa 'greng bu bya ba nu ma drang po nas sgrog rus pa'i 'og tu 'gro ste/ de chod na nang du chu ser 'bab mi nus/ nad mi slong ste glo cung zad 'ong*/ glo rtsa bsnol ma zhes bya ba/ nu ma nas phar mtshon gang 'jal ba na sgro rus phan chad rgyu ba de glo ba'i rtsa yin te/ de chod na brang dang sog dbrag gzer | sngas dma' na nyal mi shes par glo 'ong*/ de la rtsa'i yar sna mar sna bsreg cing gtar/ bse ru bdun pa btang ste/

bse ru/ gur gum/ cu gang*/ ba le ka sum cu tig ga pur ro/ /tshigs pa lnga pa nas phan tshun mtshon re 'jal ba na glo'i rtsa yod/ mchan 'og gru mo'i bkug mtshams nas rgyab ngos su chag gang bcal ba na/ glo rtsa mgo rdum bya ba yod de/ de chad pa'i rtags/ thal gong skrangs/ nu ma'i 'og tu gzer 'byung*/ sbrid pa mang la phyi'i sha skrangs/ byad snum zhing bad kan skyugs/ dpyad ma byas na chu ser dang tsha ba nang du 'khrid pa'i rtsa yin no/ /sog pa'i 'dab nas/ chag gang bcal ba na rtsib ma zhes gsum yod de/ de na glo rtsa sur ya ga dor bya ba yod de/ de chod na rtag tu kha nas glo khrag 'ong*/ de la rtsa'i yar sna mar sna bsreg dpung pa'i rtsa gtar/ nang du chu ser 'chor ba'i dogs pa yod do/ /glo rtsa sngon mo zhes bya ba/ sog pa'i me long gi dkyil na yod de/ rtsa'i dbyibs ni rta rnga tsam gcig sbrul lam bzhag bzhin gnas te/ de chod dam bzher ba'i rtags/ lus po lci la byad nag cing glo 'ong*/ tshad pa skye/ de la phog na rus pa'i nad dang bcas nas 'chi/ chu ser nang du 'chor te/ de bcos thabs ga pur bdun pa bsten/ glo rtsa rkyang pa kun gtar/ bsil thang drag po kun gtang ngo*/ /de rnams ni glo rtsa gnyan pa yin te/ rtsa phran gzhan yang mang du yod do/ /mchin pa'i rtsa ni sha ba'i rwa ltar rgyas/ mcher ba'i rtsa ni skra shad 'dzings pa dang 'dra ste/ lus thams cad la khyab pas smos kyis mi lang | mkhal ma la phog na skyigs bu btud mar 'ong zhing*/ zug gzer che/ dri chu bsdams te bcos thabs med/ zhag gnyis bzhi na 'chi/ pho ba la pho rtsa 'greng bu bya ba gnyis yod de/ mid pa dang 'brel nas ol mdud pa'i nang du 'gro bas/ de chod na pho sbau/ sgregs pa yong bas/ mtshog sgo bsreg go /pho ba'i ther la mtshon song na/ bcos mi dgos so/ /rdzems la ma song na/ rtsam pa kha le byung yang mi 'chi/ mkhris pa mchin pa'i dbus na gnas te/ de la song na snod kyi don snod yin te/

bcos pa'i thabs med do/ /lus po ser lam gyis song nas khar rtsang brgyab pa'i dus na 'chi/ long la song na yang rma khar mkhris pa 'ong*/ 'phongs su byung na bcos mi dgos/ long gi rdzems la song na zhag bzhi'am lnga na 'chi/ long gi gnye ma la song na skad ngan 'tsher zhing dud khur skyugs nas/ zhag bdun nas 'chi/ bsam se'u bya ba ming yod la gzugs med pa | dper na chu zla dang 'dra ste/ don snying rnam pa lnga la dbang*/ snod rnam pa drug la gtogs zer/ zas zos pa bcud du 'gyur/ skom 'thungs pa khrag tu 'gyur | ngo bo dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba la bzhag go kha cig na re khrag yin zer/ kha gcig na re srog rtsa yin zer/ kha gcig na re sha sha rmen bu yin yang zer/ de'i gsang tshigs pa bcu gsum pa yin te/ lus spyi khyab pa'i gsang yin no/ / rgyu ma la song nas chad na mi 'tsho/ /bshang gci dang dbugs rang gi gnas nas 'ong na the tshom med par 'chi/ rgyu ma lug na dang po chus bkru/ de nas ba'i 'o mas bkrus la/ mar gsar gyis bskus la/ drod phab la kha ru sgro bcug la skyug tu bcug des ma song na/ rkang pa'i 'og tu gtan pa bcug la/ steng du tho ba 'phyar la rkang pa bcag dogs byas la/ des bsdigs te/ des tshud nges so// rang rang gi gnas su ma song na 'khrugs nas 'chi/ nang du song nas nang gi pags pa rta dkar po'i rgyus pa bangs par sbangs la/ mi sgril bar btsems/ bar du bcad 'byor dang*/ sman bzang po dang*/ dom mkhris la sogs pa gdab | phyi'i pags pa dar skud dam por mi btsems/ lhod de byas la/ rma kha dar gyis bcad/ tshil bu dron mos rgyu zhabs khebs par bya/ de nas ras bal mar la btsos pa glan/ rgyu zhabs khebs pa'i phying pa srab la mkhregs pa gtang | ro smad sham bus bcings/ gan rkyal du bsnyal la yan lag so sor brkyang la/ zhag bcu gcig dgye dgu mi bya/ bla 'og mi bsgyur/ de nas yan lag cha yis bskum/ bco lnga nas lus cha la dbab/

nyer gcig nas bslangs la zas skom ran par bza'o/ /byang khog smad du rnag khrag shor ba ma tshor na/ zas skom btang bas/ khong sbo ba'am/ chu 'gags pa'am/ 'khru ba'am/ zug gzer che na khrag ngan nang na yod pa'i rtags yin/ de la long rtsa gnyis gtar/ ni ru ha gtang ngo*/ /phyi'i rma bcos ni/ ras bal mar du btsos pa dang*/ rma kha sbang mas non par gtang*/ phyi'i rma dkris ras ma sdig pa 'dra ba gcig byas la/ rwa gnyis kyis rked pa bskor/ mjug ma ring du byas la mar bskor ro/ /rnag zhugs pa la sla ngar chu dang bag phye sbyar la lug zho tsam me la bsros la rma la bsku | de'i thog tu ri bong gi spus mnan/ de'i steng du bag phyes mnan/ rma'i thad kar har mig bya'o/ /byer ba kun gyi rma bcos pa yin no/ /bshul sha'i rma la brag zhun dang*/ bu ram dang*/ bag phye/ zho la sogs pa'i skam chas bya'o/ / sbang ma btab na bshul sha 'drul lo/ /ltag sha'i rma la gar po dang mkhan pa tshags byas la btsags la spos dang mar nag bsres la/ sla ngar bsros la ltag sha 'khros pa la gtang te/ a spangs pa'i nan bya'o/ /spyir mchin dri yan chod stod kyi rma la skam chas dang bsil gyis bcos te/ chu rtsa'i phye ma zho dang sbyar la byug go /smad kyi rma thams cad gar po la spod btab pa dang*/ re bal mar du btsos pa gtang ngo*/ /mdor na stod kyi rma la bsil chas bya/ smad kyi rma rnams drod bcos bya'o/ /spyir byang khog stod du mtshon phog nas phyi ru khrag gtan ma byung na phal cher 'chi ste/ gtar yang khrag mi 'byung ngo*/ /stod kyi zas bcos ni/ spyir yang bsil dang skom rts-i btang ste/ ra'i mar gsar dang*/ drus thug dang*/ dar ba gsar pa dang*/ ba zho gtang ngo*/ /smad la zho dkrugs dang zan dron gtang*/ grang ba che na tsho khu gtang*/ pho ba dang*/ rgyu ma la chang gsar 'jam gtang*/ spyir smad la zas drod can dang 'jam pa gtang ngo*/ /rlung gis rnag gzhug ma chod na/ a ru ra'i 'bri rkang gtang*/

grang bas ma chod na drod sbyor dang*/ snag gsod gtang*/ tshad pas ma chod na/ bse ru dang*/ gwa dor gtang | rtsa'i rnag la thal sman gtang*/ thigs sdod la mu zi'i sbyor ba min pas mi skems so/ /rnag dkar la 'jam na gso ba sla/ chu dwangs na gso ru 'dod/ mtshal mdog 'dra na bla rtsa chad pas spong ngo*/ /de yang zhag lnga tshun chad khrag gi dus | bcu gcig tshun chad chu ser gyi dus/ de las 'das na rnag tu 'gyur ro// dang po chu ser gyi dus su/ chu ser nag po rol du gsod pa zhes bya ste/ bse ru dang | sha ba'i gwa dor bzhur ba dang*/ ga pur dang*/ cu gang*/ ba le ka tig ta/ ba sha ka rgun 'brum/ sug smel/ mtshal/ dom mkhris/ tsandan dkar po/ ka rar sbyar te/ chu grang gis phul la khye sus la btang na/ chu ser rol du gsod pa'i mchog yin no/ /sman dang zas mi 'dzol bar gtang ngo*/ /nad pa srog gi mdangs nyams pa dang*/ lus zungs shor ba dang*/ tshad pa 'bar ba ni 'chi ba'i rtags so/ /dbang po 'khrul ba dang*/ yan lag 'dar ba dang*/ mig 'bras gyen la bzlog pa ni 'chi ba'i rtags yin no/ /mdor na don snying lnga dang*/ snod gnyen po drug la bcos pa'i thabs med do/ /de rnams bzher ba dang*/ brdungs pa dang/ nyen pa rnams bcos su 'dod do/ /rnag ngos ma zin na/ gang dgos pa'i sar/ chus kha phru btab la nyi ma la bsro/ rnag dang chu ser gang na yod pa ba spu nyal lo/ /dang po khong gi tshad pa gdar sha bcad pa'i sman ni/ ga pur/ cu gang | ba sha ka bse ru/ dom mkhris rnams med thabs med pa'i sman lnga yin te | ka ra dang sbyar nas btang bas tshad pa gdar sha chod do/ /glo skam rtag tu 'ong ba la/ skyes pa'i lag pa g.yas kyi mtheb gnyis/ bud med kyi g.yon bsregs na phan no/ /glau ba la rnag 'ong ba la/ dbyi mong*/ rgya tshwa/ po son 'cha' | tsha ba gsum ka ra sbyar te btang na rnag skyugs te/ 'phral du phan no/ / thur ma'i dbyibs ni/ glo snying gi thur ma nas 'dra ba/

mchin pa dang*/ mcher pa'i thur ma kha leb sbal mgo 'dra ba/ bshul ba'i thur ma chu gri lta bur srab par bya/ tshigs thur khab 'dra bar bya/ dmu chu'i thur ma smyu gu kha phra la gsang ba'o | | mgo bo'i thur ma sog kha'o/ /mig thur sor lnga bra bo 'dra ba'o/ /de nas byang khog gi gsang legs por phye la/ rma kha skyed pa'i skyed thems shu dag dang yungs ma gzhug sdom thems dar man gyis bya/ 'phrul thems nya re dang*/ sgrau rtsa dang*/ gro ga gsum las bya ste/ mchog gro ga yin no/ /rnag sha gcod pa'i sman gtang*/ 'tsho ba'i dus 'char lugs gcig byung nas/ sngo lo 'bus pa dang | rtsa skam thag chad nas/ 'khyag pa cham cham 'chad dus gcig yin no/ / byang khog nas/ dpyad kyis khrag rdol na/ mkhris pa sna tshogs khong du gtang ngo*// bsdu ba'i rnag gi kha dog rgya skyegs kyi khu ba 'dra na/ zla ba gsum na 'chi'o/ / don snying gi 'o ma lus phyed kyi rten/ srog phyed kyi gnad mchin pa la thur ma thad du spangs te/ gal te mtshon phog na yang*/ rkang lag sdud mi shes/ kha sna nas khrag 'ong ste/ zan gcig bza' ran na 'chi'o/ /mchin pa'i yol ba mchin dri la phog na chu ma bu 'dre/ srid pa'i sum 'khrugs zhes bya ste/ stod khrag smad du lhung nas 'chi'o//

//mkhal ma ni srog pa rtsa'i dpyang rdo/ don snying gi then thag yin te/ thur ma thams cad du spang*/ mtshon phog na yang bong breng gis btang nas lus kyog por song nas 'chi'o/ /spyir nad ldog pa'i dus ni/ mgo bo'i zhag bcu gsum yin | ske'i zhag dgu yin/ byang khog smad kyi zhag bco brgyad/ tshigs gzhi'i ldog dus zhag grangs gcig yin/ tshigs khol bu'i zhag lnga yin/ gdams ngag 'di ni chu'i nang nas lan tshwa dang 'dra'o/ /gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las byang khog chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i le'u rdzogs sau/ /'phags pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa 'di las 'phros pas byang khog la ming btags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang*/ 'dir 'dus pa yin gsung ngo || || ༈ oṃ swasti singnghaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad pa bcos pa'i gdams ngag sdug bsngal zhi byed ces bya ba 'di la lnga ste/ ma sm-in pa'i tsha ba chu ltar rnyog pa dang*/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba me ltar 'bar ba dang*/ stongs pa'i tsha ba mda' ltar gzer ba dang*/ gab pa'i tsha ba mun ltar gtibs pa dang*/ rnying pa'i tsha ba rtsi ltar zhen pa'o/ /dang po chu ltar rnyog pa ni/ ma smin pa'i tshad pa ste/ grang shum byed/ tshigs gzhi na/ za zi mang*/ me dang nyi ma 'dod/ sems las che ba'o/ /de ni rlung dang bad kan gyi dus su smin du ma ster ba'o/ /nad drag po dang mkhris pa shas che ba dang*/ nam zla ston gyi dus dang | kha zas drod can zos pa dang*/ spyod lam drag shul byas na smin pa sla'o/ / ma smin pa smin par bya ba ni/ 'bras bu gsum gyi thang dang*/ skyu ru ra'i chig thang dang | ma nu bzhi thang gis smin par bya'o/ /smin pa'i rtags ni/ sngar gyi rtags rnams chad nas gzer du 'dril nas 'ong ste/ snying la zas bsil ba 'dod pa dang | rtsa 'phar dma' la grims pa dang*/ chu mdog dmar por 'ong ba'o/ /de ltar smin pa de la sle tres kyi thang gis nad dwangs snyigs dbye/

bsil gyi thang btang zhing rtsa rnams gtar ro/ /smin pa'i dus su zhag grangs la nges pa med/ dper na nad smin pa ni/ chu rnyog pa dwangs pa dang 'dra'o/ /nad ma smin par gtar na/ zug gzer slar la skye'o/ /la la shes pa byings nas 'gro/ lus kyi zungs 'dzad/ tsha ba rnyog pa yin pas chu ser skye/ srog 'dor te/ nad khrag dang zungs khrag chu ma 'dres pa ltar gyur nas/ sman pas tsha grang gang yang ngo mi shes te | de la 'jam thang gtang*/ kha zas drod can gyi bcud la bsdus la de nas gtang | bsil sman gtang*/ kha zas ba lang gi sha gtang*/ byug pa bag re yang bya'o | | rgyas pa'i tsha ba me ltar 'bar ba ni/ lus kyi dpyad la drag shul dang*/ rgyu 'khrugs pa dang*/ rtsa 'khrugs pa dang*/ drag shul byas pas rlung skyes nas/ rlung gi khrag chur gyur pa dang*/ chang 'thungs nas me dang nyi tshan la gnyid log pa dang*/ mdor na drag shul gyi las mi 'tsham pa byas pas 'jug pa yin/ de la khrag dang mkhris pa gnyis tsha ba yin par don gcig ste/ rgyas na yang rgyas par mthun/ stongs na yang stongs par mthun no/ /'di yi rtags ni spyi dang mthun pa las/ khyad par du rtsa drag la mkhrang ba dang*/ gzer mi 'pho bar thong nge yod pa dang*/ chu dmar ba dang*/ khrag la rnag dang*/ mkhris pa la chags pa dang | dbugs rgod la lus kyi drod che ba'o/ /de la dang po bsil thang bzang pos khrag rnams rtsa ru bsdus la/ ro stod na na stod kyi rtsa rnams gtar/ mgo bo na na dpral ba'i gser mdung gtar/ snying la snying gi a so gtar/ glo'i nad la rtse'u chung dang sgang rtsa gtar/ pho ba dang mchin pa na na snod kha dang ru thung gtar | mkhal ma na na/ long rtsa dang byin gzhug gtar/ long la yang long rtsa gtar | bsil sman ci rigs pa gtang ngo*/ /de yang rtsa'i rgyal po rtse'u chung dang*/ sman gyi rgyal po ga pur la brten nas/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba thog babs su bsad/ rtsa'i blon po glo rtsa gal mdo dang*/ sman gyi blon po cu gang gur gum la brten nas tsha ba rkyang khrid du bsad/

rtsa'i phyag tshang ba mkhris rtsa dang*/ sman gyi phyag tshang ba tig ta la brten nas tsha ba zag bcad/ go rim de ltar ma bcos na/ lud pa ser por 'gro'o/ /spyod lam gseng*/ nyin par dang srod la gnyid bsrung | shes pa gseng*/ zas drod bag bsrung*/ chab tsha dang*/ dar ba chus bslad pa dang*/ ra'i 'o ma skol grang dang*/ khur ma'i tshod ma gtang ngo*/ /na tshod rgan pa dang*/ rlung shas che ba rnams la/ skam sha dang bsil sha gtang ngo*/ /snying la tshad pa kham chen byung na/ bsil sman 'tshogs tshad dang*/ bshal gyis bcos | chu bzhi yang bsten no/ /yen la gtad pa zas kyi chu dang*/ rtsa 'dren pa khrag gi chu dang*/ bsil sar sdod pa spyod lam gyi chu dang*/ bsil dgu bsten pa sman gyi chu rnams bsten pas tshad pa byang ba'i rtags rnams 'byung ste/ de nas kha zas rim gyis klod do/ /tshad pa byang ba'i rtags kha zas 'ju stobs chung ba dang | sngar gyi gos kyis mi dros pa dang*/ gdong pa skya seng nge 'ongs pa dang*/ chu yang sngo dwangs 'ongs pa dang*/ nyi mas mi sdang tsam na tshad pa zad pa yin pas kha zas klod/ tshad pa byang ba'i rtags kha zas zos pa'i rjes la/ zas kyis tshad pa ldang mi nus te/ dper na thal tshan gyi drod dang 'dra/ bsil sbyor drags pas nyes pa bskyed pa'ang yod de/ de bas na zhus 'khyags bar gyi sman pa ni rgyun shes bu dang 'dra yang gzabs gsung ngo*/ /stongs pa'i tshad pa mda' ltar gzer ba bcos pa ni/ gzhi rlung shas che ba la lus ngag yid kyi las ches pa dang | skad mthon pos bos pa dang*/ cho nge drag pos btab pa dang*/ yid kyis mya ngan drags pa dang*/ sems las chen po byas pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i bsam mno skyes pa las 'byung*/ gzhan yang 'khrugs chung ngu dang*/ rims phra mo la gtar ga dang*/ bsil sman drags pa las 'byung ngo*/ /yang na gong gi tshad pa rgyas pa'i tsha ba bcos rdugs drags pa'i rjes la yang 'byung ngo*/ /yang gzhi rlung du yod pa la ga pur dang bsil sman drags na gzer nad drag po 'byung ste/

de'i rtags lus ngag yid gsum bya ba spang ba dang*/ rtsa stong rgyug tu 'ong*/ kha skam | dbugs rgod/ g.yal dang sbrid pa mang*/ lus kyi gzer 'pho/ rkang lag brkyang bskum mang*/ chu 'thungs kyang skom/ ma 'thungs kyang bsran thub/ chu mdog dmar ser me dang 'dra ba/ drag cing rtsub pa'i nad de 'dra gcig byung na gso ru mi btub bo/ /de la yang sna la gsur gyis bdug bsku mnye bag re bya/ des lce rlon du song na/ de la nges pa bskyed la tsho khu dang*/ bu ram chang gtang*/ ba phran gyi sha gtang*/ skom du dar ba gsar 'jam gtang*/ yang na bu ram rnying pa dang sbrang rtsi g.yung gtang*/ tig ta'i sman mar btang bas/ rlung dang khrag mkhris dus gcig la sel/ an chen stong rus dang*/ spyi gtsug dang*/ tshigs pa drug pa/ bdun pa dang*/ mdun gyi snying dkar nag gi mtshams rnams su me btsa' gdab/ rus khu'i nang du sgog skya gdus la gtang*/ de'i rjes la rngul dbyung | des tshad pa 'jil bar 'gyur ro/ /gzer zhing na nas cung zad mjug lus pa 'dra na/ sle trais dang skyu ru ra'i thang btang bas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /des kyang zhi bar ma nus na gur gum bdun pa gtang*/ yang rlung legs par zhi ba dang | cung zad gtar la sems las bskyungs te/ yid dang mthun pa'i grogs bsten | me dang nyi ma la mi 'dug go /gzhan yang stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes bya ba/ rkang lag dang rus pa na ba dang*/ gnyid mi 'ong la/ cho 'phrul mang ba dang*/ lus dbal skya la skra 'thas/ 'dar na rims nad stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes bya ba yin no/ /de la gtar du mi rung*/ grib ma la gnyid du gzhug lug sha dang*/ chang gtang*/ bsku mnye bag re bya'o/ /'di drod bcos 'ba' zhig gis thub par nges so/ /gzhan yang khrag stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes bya ba/ nyin mtshan med par gnyid che ba dang*/ gnyid bslangs na grogs la rgol ba'o/ /de la chang gtang du mi rung*/ sha gsar pa gtang*/ bsku mnye bag tsam bya/ nyin mo gnyid du mi gtang ngo*/

/me btsa' mi bya/ 'jam thang gtang bas thub par 'gyur ro/ / mkhris pa stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes bya ba/ gnyid mi 'ong bar bla 'chol smra ba dang*/ lus dbal skya la mig dang lce ser ba'o/ /de la sha chang bsdams la gnyid bsrung*/ bsku mnye bya/ bsil thang gtang*/ bshal bya/ des thub par 'gyur ro/ /yang bad kan stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes bya ba/ gnyid log na za zi mang | shin tu nyon mongs shing mi bde la/ rngul chu bzhin du 'ong ngo*/ /de la 'bras bu gsum gyi thang gtang*/ bsku mnye bya/ des thub par 'gyur ro/ /yang chu ser stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes bya ba nyin mtshan med par gnyid mi khug la mig sngar za zi mang ba dang*/ skabs su dbang po 'khrul ba dang*/ dngangs pa dang*/ smyo tshul ston pa'o/ /de la sha rnying mar rnying khu ba gtang*/ gnyid 'ong tshad log tu gzhug 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar gtang*/ tshigs pa lnga pa dang*/ bdun pa bsreg des thub par 'gyur ro/ /glo snying stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes bya ba/ skabs su lus rengs pa dang*/ so 'thems nas mi byed pa dang*/ skabs su bla 'chol 'ong ba dang*/ gnyid chung ba'o/ /de la thang rnams gtang du mi rung ste/ rus pa rnying pa'i skol thang btang*/ bsku mnye bya/ gnyid mi bsrung bar log tu gzhug tshigs pa lnga pa dang*/ bdun pa bsreg des thub par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang de rnams kyi nang nas gso dka' ba ni/ mig ri la lta ba dang*/ kha khu yis 'debs pa dang*/ 'di rnams kyang stongs pa'i tsha ba yin te gso dka'o/ /yang dar la babs pa rnams la 'khrugs sam rims byung ba'i mjug la/ rtsa dus nye bar 'phar zhing*/ sha ser la skom dad che ba dang*/ lus kyi drod che la nyam chung ba dang | dbugs thung la skra 'dab 'dar ba ni/ nad kyi tsha ba yin/ sman rtsub mos nyam smad nas dpyad kyis me bus pa bya ba yin te/ nad kyi mtshan nyid ma shes pas 'khrul nas tshad pa zhu 'khyags kyi bar du gsad pa mang ba yin pas de la bsku mnye byas pa gzer 'joms/

tshigs pa drug pa bdun pa la me btsa' bya | rngul cung zad 'don/ de nas gnyid phebs nas 'ong ngo*/ /spyir tsha ba 'chos pa la/ dka' dus gsum yod de/ zhu 'khyags kyi bar du nor nas gsad pa mang bas 'dir gzabs/ rlung dang bad kan gnyid gzhi che na/ zhu 'khyags kyi mtshams gsal ba yin te/ zas 'ju stobs chung*/ sngar gyi gos kyis mi dros/ rtsa dal du 'gro/ dbugs sna ring du 'gro khrag gi gzer 'bri/ skom dad chung du 'gro de las thal na mig phug skrangs pas de la sha chang dang*/ drod btang bas bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /de las thal ba dang*/ gtar ga mang nas dmu chur song ba yang yod de 'di bag 'khrul pa chung*/ rlung shas che na/ 'di la 'khrul pa mang bas skabs su tsho khu tsha med gtang ngo*/ /zas snga ru klod la sman gzhug bsring*/ yang stongs pa'i tsha ba snying la shor na/ bya ba glo snying gi tsha ba stongs pa dang 'dra ba las/ gtso bor rims 'khrugs pa las 'byung ste/ lus mdangs chung la/ sna lce skams la/ rngam pa che/ tshig 'chol 'khrul 'ong*/ skabs su shes pa dwangs/ mkhur ba smug la zas mi tshud na/ de la ji ltar tsha yang gtar tu mi rung ste/ tshigs pa'i rus pa khral khrol du brdungs shing btsos la | tshang ra la dugs bya'o/ /de'i khu ba ngad yal ba la sbrang rtsi cung zhig btab la blud/ de nas byibs la rngul dbyung*/ rgod sha'i tshod ma gtang*/ sbang ma chang 'gag gi nye'u la bu ram btab la gtang*/ des kha lce rlon la dbang po gsal bar gyur na/ tshigs pa lnga pa bdun pa bsreg chang gtang*/ lug sha gtang du mi btub bo/ /des thub par 'gyur ro/ /gab pa'i tsha ba mun ltar gtibs pa bcos pa'i thabs ni/ 'di'i nad kyi rgyu ni/ mchin pa las gyur pa yin te/ tsha ba grang rlung gis sbas pa'o/ /'di'i man ngag med pa'i sman pa rnams kyis ngos mi zin te/ snying la gab na nyi ma la mi tshugs par grib ma la snyegs pa dang*/ srod la gnyid mi khug pa dang*/ sen mo dkar/

snying gar sha khra bo 'ong*/ byad la srin thor dmar po rgyun mi 'chad par yong*/ chang rnying 'thungs na nad de ldang ngo | | des kyang yid ma ches na/ snying rtsa la khrag gcig phyung la bltas pas khrag ngan na yin no/ /mkhal ma la gab na/ mkhal ma'i zag chu rtag tu yong ngo*/ /chu bzhag na dmar nag tu 'gro 'gro 'dug byas na chu sdom zhing na/ las dang 'gro 'dug byas na rkang pa lci ru 'gro mkhal rtsa gang na yod pa'i sa thams cad na/ chang bzang po 'thungs pas rkang pa lci ru 'gro des kyang yid ma ches na/ long rtsa cung zhig gtar la gtang*/ rnag tu byung na nges par yin no/ /pho mchin la gab na | lus grang na na/ dros na yang phur pa btsugs pa bzhin 'dril nas yong*/ kha zas dang skom yang 'jam tsam byas na phan/ grang drags pa dang*/ tsha drags pa dang gnyis ka gnod par 'gyur ro/ /des kyang yid ma ches na/ ru thung gtar la blta/ khrag la rnag chags pa na nges pa yin no/ /lus la gab pa'i tshad pa ni/ lus po lci la shed chung*/ rngul kha snyi/ zas kyi ro mi tshor/ des kyang yid ma ches na | rtse'u chung dang*/ ru thung gtar nas bltas pas/ rnag bya wang rgyab 'dra ba cig chags na yin nges so/ /'di thams cad kyi rtsa mthun par rus pa'i steng na/ rta rnga tsam cig mkhrang la/ grims shing byings la rgyug na yin no/ /'di'i bcos thabs ni/ gang du bab kyang tshabs chai na rtsa yas babs su gtar/ de nas gang du bab pa'i sar gtar/ gang du bab kyang ru thung mi gtar du mi rung ngo*/ /sman sbyar thabs ni/ snying la babs na/ ga pur tsandan shis/ pho ba dang mchin pa mkhal ma la gur gum drag zhun gtang ngo*/ /spyir gang gab pa'i tsha ba la 'jam bshal shis pa yin/ tshad pa chog nas so so'i gsang du me btsa' gdab bo/ / 'dir rgyas pa'i tsha ba dang mi 'dra ste/ tshad pa zad zad gtar mi rung ngo*/ kha zas snga ru klod dgos te/ snying la zas klod pa phyis na/ snying rlung 'jug pho mchin la zas klod pa phyis na/ skran dang dmu chur 'gro mkhal ma'i nad la zas klod pa phyis na chu bsdams pa dang*/

rkang lag zha ba dang*/ sgur por 'gro'o/ / rnying pa'i tsha ba rtsi ltar zhen pa ni/ tshad pa lkugs pa bya ba yin te/ 'di'i rgyu rkyen ni | dang po'i tshad pa yin pa la/ bcos pa phyis na rnyings pa yin te/ de la kha zas dang*/ spyod lam dang*/ sman dang*/ dpyad kyis rnyings te/ bsten ma legs pas tsha ba lus la 'dril nas zhen pa yin te/ des na ma smin pa btar ga sngas na dpyad kyis rnyings pa yin te/ tshad pa bya shor ba'o/ /sman gyis rnyings pa ni/ sman rtsub mo sngas drags pa las 'byung ngo*/ /gnyid ma bsrungs na spyod lam gyis rnyings pa yin te/ kha zas kyis rnyings pa ni/ nam zas kyi dus tshod ma zin par na ba la sogs pa sngas pa las 'byung ngo*/ /tsha ba rnyings pa'i rtags ni/ rtsa phran rgyun ring ba dang*/ rngul kha snyi la nyam shed dma' ba dang*/ grib ma la snyeg cing*/ me dang nyi ma la 'dug na shes pa lci/ lce chung gi steng du dreg pa 'chags | dang ga bde'o/ /de la 'jam thang yun ring du gtang*/ khrag la nad babs ma babs yun ring du bltas pas/ rnag bya wang rgyab 'dra ba cig chags na bcos sla ba yin/ rtsa kha mang du dbye/ nyams dang sbyar la bag re dbyung ngo*/ /

sman ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga pa gtang*/ dpe gnyis la 'bras bu gsum byung 'bri ta rgyun du gtang | brag zhun btul ma gtang*/ kha zas ba sha gsar pa dang dar ba gtang*/ des lus po je yang je yang 'gro'o/ /bshal btang na yang dga'/ des tshad pa zhen pa thon nges so/ /nad 'chos pa la/ dos drags la gnyug thung na skyon gsum | zhen pa'i nad mi thon/ pho ba'i me drod 'chi/ thor bu'i rlung skye'o/ /'di ni rtsa dang*/ don snod dang*/ rus pa la zhen pas sel dka'o/ /mjug tu gur gum bdun pa'am/ tig ta'i sman mar gtang ngo*/ khrag la rnag ma chags par bse rnying pa lta bur byung na/ nad lci bas mang po gtar du mi rung ngo*/ /de la ga pur nyi shu rtsa lnga pa mang du sbyar la gtang*/ kha zas sngar dang 'dra/ 'di la bshal mchog tu shis pa yin/ de la bcos ka lan 'ga' byas pas ma phan kyang*/ yid ma gsad par yun ring du bcos so/ /dper na dbyar gyi sngo lo 'gyur ba dang 'dra ste/ lo zla 'das nas nams sos cha med pa 'ong ngo*/ /nad rnying pa shed chung ba la lug sha sil bu dang*/ chang 'jam pos shed bskyed la bshal gtang ngo*/ / tsha ba rgan po la tshigs pa bcu pa bsreg des tsha ba 'dus pa dang ldan pa la phan | kha zas phyogs med la bslabs la/ tshad ro ldang ngam mi ldang brtag go / tsha ba spyi bcos pa'i man ngag tsha ba sde lnga zhes bya ba bstan zin tau// //༈ mdor na rgyas pa'i tshad pa zhes bya ba drag po de la bsil sman tsam gtang*/ tsha ba sde lnga char la bshal sman de khyad par du rtsa bshal shes so/ / rtse chung la sogs pa rtsa chen gtar/ nad gang la babs pa dang*/ gang gzer ba'i rtsa gtar/ khrag gang ngan pa'i rtsa gtar/ de ni tsha ba klad bcag pa'o/ / nad bsgyur ba ni/ ga pur/ gur gum/ cu gang dang gsum kar dang sbyar la gtang | de'i steng du ba le ka utpal sngon po/ pu shel tse/ a ru ra/ ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar ba ga pur bdun pa zhes bya ste/ de gtang ngo*/ /de yang gur gum bdun pa zhes bya ba ni/

gur kum/ ba le ka pha 'ong gi dreg pa/ utpal sngon po/ sug smel/ mtshe'i tshigs pa rnams dang ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /de yang nad dang bstun dgos te/ snying la tsha ba shor na/ ga pur bdun pa gtang*/ glo ba la shor na shing mngar bdun pa gtang*/ mchin pa la shor na gur kum bdun pa gtang*/ mcher pa la shor na sug smel bdun pa gtang*/ pho ba dang mkhris pa la shor na gser gyi me tog bdun pa gtang*/ bshal bya/ mkhal ma la shor na a ru ra bdun pa gtang ngo*/ /yang tsha ba rol du gsad pa ni/ las so so yin te/ glo'i 'khrugs la ba le ka'i thang gtang*/ snying gi 'khrugs la skyu ru ra'i thang gtang*/ mchin pa la ba sha ka'i thang gtang*/ mkhris pa la tig ta dang gser gyi me tog gi thang gtang*/ gal te rlung gis 'khrugs na rus khu mchog tu phan no/ /glo 'gog tu mi 'dod pa la/ ga pur gyi steng du star bu bsngags so/ / lud pa kham ser byung na/ ga pur dang*/ gla rtsis phan no/ /lud pa khrag tu song na | ga pur gyi steng du mtshal bzang po bsngags/ lud pa rnag tu 'ong ba la/ ga pur steng du bse ru bsngags/ gur gum cu gang star bu dang*/ shing mngar/ rgun 'brum | pu tse shel/ tsandan dkar dmar/ a ru ra/ ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar la gtang | glo'i sman la lud pa nag po 'ong na/ gtar ba 'phro bcad la/ sman gyis gso'o/ /pu tse shel bdun pa ni/ pu tse shel dang*/ a ru ra/ li ga dur dang | sle tres dang*/ a bi ṣa dang*/ kyi lce ba/ rgun 'brum/ de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba ni rims sna tshogs dang*/ glo dang*/ mchin pa'i tsha ba dang*/ khrag mkhris tsha ba kun la phan/ spyir hong len dang*/ par pa ta/ sle tres/ kaṇḍa ka ri bzhi'i thang spyi khyab tu gtang ngo*/ /thang ma btang bar rtsa gtar na/ nyes skyon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ srog khrag nad la 'chor ro/ /sngon kha zas ma btang bar yang rtsa mi gtar ro/ /rtsub thang zhes bya ba ni/ ba le ka a ru ra/ tig ta/ li ga dur/

a bi ṣa/ sle tres/ kyi lce ba/ dug mo nyung/ pu tse shel/ de rnams kun gyi khu ba btang na/ tshad pa mtha' dag sel nges so/ /mkhris pa pho bar lud nas skyugs pa la/ gser gyi me tog nyi shu/ dug mo nyung bcu/ zhib par btags la chu la thang du bskol la gtang ngo*/ /des phan nges so/ /rlung tshad bsdongs na chu'i lam nas khrag tu 'ong ngo*/ /brag zhun/ star bu/ lcam ba'i lo ma | byi ba'i ril ma rnams chang gsar pa la sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /des sel lo/ / da ni glo'i nad bcos thabs bstan par bya ste/ nad kyi rgyu ni khrag las gyur pa'i nad yin te/ rkyen lus kyis stobs drag po phyung ba dang*/ mya ngan dang sems las ches pa dang*/ nad gzhi gsum 'khrugs pa'am/ 'byung po'i gdon gyis bslang ba rnams so/ /de yi rtags ni/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba dang mthun pa las/ khyad par du mgo na ba la phrum ser khyer ba'o/ /de la lud pa phal cher khrag tu 'ong bas | de la gtar ga mi bya/ bse ru bdun pa sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /rgya skyegs/ ldum bu re ral/ skyu ru ra/ ba sha ka de rnams bsdus pa'i thang gtang*/ nad drus ma'i thug pa dang*/ 'bras thug zho gtang*/ kha zas bcud can thams cad spang ngo | | dang po rang du lud pa ser po dang*/ dud kha la sogs byung na/ rtse'u chung dang | rtsa chen rnams yas 'babs su gtar/ ga pur bdun pa gtang ngo*/ / yang na ga pur/ gur kum dang*/ utpal sngon po/ ba le ka mtshal/ tsandan dkar dmar dang*/ bse ru/ de rnams cha bsnyams la/ ka ra drug 'gyur dang sbyar la/ gangs chus phul ba gtang ngo*/ /des lud pa ser po dang*/ dud ka rnams sos kha'i 'khyag pa bzhin du 'joms so/ /ur shi dang*/ tig ta/ skyu ru ra'i thang nang ma gcig bzhin gtang ngo*/ /snying la tsha ba zhugs na/ kha dang lce skams la/ mig sprin dmar/ dran pa nyams shing*/ rtsa phra/ chu dmar la ska na/ ga pur tsandan dkar po dang*/ cu gang*/ gur gum/ dzā ti rnams/ ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar te gtang*/ rngul byung na/

snying gi tshad pa myur du 'joms so/ /yang glo ba la/ tsandan dkar po/ a ga ru nag po/ gi wang*/ spang rgyan dkar po/ cu gang | gur gum/ rgun 'brum/ shing mngar/ 'bu su hang*/ srol lo dkar po rnams zhib par btags la/ ka ra brgyad 'gyur dang sbyar nas/ btang na glo'i tshad pa 'joms/ yang na/ li shi li ga dur/ ur shi gsum po bskol thang la/ cu gang dang gur gum/ ka ra gsum btab nas btang yang glo tshad 'joms/ spyir bdo ba'i dus su phye ma'i sbyor ba thams cad pas/ ga pur rkyang rgyug dga' ba yin no/ /de'i rjes la ga pur dang cu gang*/ gur gum gsum gtang ngo*/ /glo tshad kha lce skam pa la/ so phag gi thang btang na dang ga gribs pas mi gtang ngo*// de la ldum bu re ral bsdus pa'i khu ba'i grang thang shis so/ /gur kum/ cu gang*/ ka ra'i zag thun gyis kha lce skam pa sel/ de rnams shin tu phan par bshad do// yang glo tsha bzhab po zhes bya ba lud pa gting du 'khyims pa yin te/ dang ga mi bde | kha lce skam/ ro stod dang*/ brang rgyangs nas na*/ tsha ba che la lus po lci/ glo mi thon par thang thang lu/ bag re khog pa'i gseb tu rnag khrag til 'bru tsam song na/ de la glo skyugs gtang ngo*/ /de'i lud pa 'byin pa'i sman ni/ cu gang*/ sug smel/ ba le ka nā ga ge sar/ nā ga puṣpa/ utpal sngon po/ ur shi dang*/ ldum bu re ral rdo dreg rnams/ ka ra brgyad 'gyur dang sbyar nas btang na bdud rtsi dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar sman btang bas/ lud pa gtsang du song ba dang*/ ro stod kyi zug gzer chag nas/ gtar ga'i khrag dmar du song ba dang*/ rtsa dal la snyoms pa dang*/ skom dad chung la kha lce rlon du song na sos par 'gyur ro/ /glo tsha'i zhag dus phal cher bdun dang*/ dgu dang*/ bcu gcig yin no/ /mi sos pa'i rtags ni/ sman dang dpyad byas pa la skyed med pa dang*/ lud pa nag por song ba dang*/ lce phugs su nag po chags pa dang*/ so la dreg pa chags pa dang*/

skom dad che ba dang*/ zug gzer che ba dang*/ dang po nas ske'am/ ltong ltong ba nas sag sag zer ba dang*/ khrag dmar po dang*/ nag po'am/ ser po/ chu rtsigs can kha ru chags pa dang*/ rtsa by-ing ba/ chu gzhug chad pa dang 'dra ba dang*/ chu ldong ros mnyes pa 'dra ba dang*/ phyi sa ser la sla ba 'ong ba dang*/ de rnams mkhas pas myur du spong*/ cig kyang skyed med pa la bshal bya ba'o/ /rlung skyes pa'i mtshan nyid ni reg na rtsub pa dang*/ lus po 'khyor ba/ ba spu ring la zing ba gtam cal col 'ong ba/ mdog ham skyar 'dug pa/ mchil ma dkar la rna ba 'ur ba gnyid chung du song ba'o/ /de la nye'u dang sha chang gis bsdu'o/ /bsdu ba phyis na rlung 'byams nas 'gro bas/ dus su bsdu shes par bya'o/ /dang po lud pa khrag tu 'ong dus su mtshal dang rgya skyegs kyi sbyor ba bya/ lud pa kham pa'i dus su ga pur bdun pa gtang*/ lud pa ser ba'i dus su ga pur rgyal blon gsum pa gtang*/ lud pa dud ka'i dus su ga pur rkyang rgyug gtang*/ lud pa nag po'i dus su phal cher gshin rje'i lag tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /glo tsha'i sgos bcos zab mo bstan zin to/ /sman dpyad phyogs re tsam la brten nas ngo mtshar che ru re ba'i ming sna tshogs btags pa'i gso dpyad mang po byas kyang nad kyi gnyen por mi 'gyur te/ sman pa'i blo yang stor nas 'gro ste/ sman gyi sbyar thabs dang*/ dpyad mang po blo la yod kyang nad thog tu mi 'bab pas/ dang la tsha ba ngos zin pa gal che'o/ /nad la brgya smos stong smos kyang*/ tsha grang gnyis su 'dus/ sman sna stong rtsa gnyis kyang bsil drod gnyis su 'dus/ tsha ba ngos zin na/ grang ba shugs las shes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar du 'dril shes na/ 'tsho byed sman pa'i mchog yin no/ /gso dpyad 'di ni sa'i nang nas gser dang 'dra'o/ /gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las tshad pa bcos pa'i man ngag sdug bsngal zhi byed ces bya ba rdzogs so//drang srong gi rgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i gso rig 'di las 'phros pa'i ming 'dogs mi 'dra ba du ma cig yod kyang 'di kho na'o/

/nad pa 'di ni 'chi 'tsho dang*/ /nad dang sman ni 'di yin zhes | | mi smra ba ni dam tshig yin/ /nad ngos zin nas mi 'chor bar/ /sman dpyad myur du byed pa spyang*/ /'chi bar shes nas spang ba spyang*/ /'bros thar shes pa shin tu dkon/ /bla ma rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phyag dpe las bris so// ༈ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad pa gso ba'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi yang thigs zhes bya ba 'di la gsum ste/ glo ba'i tsha ba bcos pa dang*/ khrag gzer bcos pa dang*/ gzer thung gnyan nad bcos pa'o/ /dang po rgyu'i tshad pa zhes bya ba/ mkhris pa'i me drod tshad las lhag pa yin te/ de ni kha zas dang*/ sman dang*/ spyod lam bsil bas bcos/ don snod gang la babs pa'i rtsa gtar bas 'tsho bar 'gyur te/ de'i nad kyi mtshan nyid ni/ dang po ma smin bar la lus thams cad phrum ser khyer zhing grang shum byed/ tshigs gzhi na/ lus thams cad tsha zhing khol/ dang ga mi bde/ rmi lam sems las za zi mang*/ 'dar zhing mgo dang yan lag na/ nyin par gnyid che/ mtshan mo mi 'ong/ de rnams tshad pa spyi'i rtags so/ /de la ma nu/ kaṇḍa ka ri/ sle tres/ sga skya'i thang gtang*/ yang na 'bras bu gsum gyi thang gtang*/ des nad myur du smin par byed do/ /smin pa'i rtags gzer 'ong*/ lus lci/ lus sgul thabs med/ skad ngan/ snying la bsil ba dang*/ grang ba 'dod | rtsa grims/ chu dmar/ gong gi khol ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'chad/ lud pa smug pa'am/ ser po la sogs pa 'byung*/ dbugs thung*/ shes pa rngam/ rtsa drag chu dmar/ khro snying 'dod/ nu mchin dang*/ snying gar gzer 'ong*/ glo mang | kha lce skam/ so dreg chags/ lce gzhung du ser po'am nag po 'byung*/ de'i dus su brtson 'grus bskyed do/ /'di yi dus su nad rlangs dang*/ sman gyi dri gnyis 'thab pas/ cu gang*/ gur gum/ li shi dang*/ utpal sngon po/ tsandan/ tig ta sbyar/

tshad pa che na ga pur dang gi wang bsnan/ ka ra brgyad 'gyur sbyar la gtang*/ des ni dper na me la chu blugs pa dang 'dra ste/ tshad pa'i rigs thams cad nges par sel bar byed do/ /yang tshad pa kha cig mda' ltar gzer ba dang*/ lud pa kham nag dud pa 'dra ba dang*/ lce ser la skam zhing thung ba dang | mchu dang so la dreg pa chags pa dang*/ de rnams ni rta g.yag 'thab pa ltar srog la gtod pa'i nad yin pas/ 'di la smin pa dang ma smin pa bya ba med de | nad dang dpyad gnyis gang mgyogs byed pas/ dang la rtsa chung ngu nas rtsa kha dbye | gzhan rig pa'i mdas dpyad do/ /de yang don snying la babs na/ gzer chen zhes bya ste/ gdong pa nag la zug gzer che/ khyi nyi mas tshig pa ltar 'ong bas | de yang dang po tig ta/ skyu ru ra sro lo'i thang gis gsad/ de nas/ ga pur | gi wang*/ cu gang dang*/ gur gum/ tsandan/ gla rtsi/ dom mkhris/ ka ra sbyar la gtang*/ de ni tsha ba rol du gsad pa'o/ /gtar gyis rtsa ru drangs/ zas kyis lus zungs gso/ gzer chen nad la bdud rtsi 'dra/ gzer chung zhes bya ba snod la babs pa ni/ lus lci/ zug gzer bag chung*/ rtsa grims/ chu dang mig ser | lud pa yang phal cher ser por 'ong ngo*/ /de la bong nga dkar po/ dug mo nyung | li ga dur dang*/ dom mkhris dang*/ gur gum/ brag zhun/ ka ra rnams sbyar la btang bas tsha ba rol du gsod/ des ma sod na bshal min pa gzhan gyis mi non pas/ dur byid/ khron bu/ lcum rtsa/ byis pa lo brgyad pa'i chu la sbyar la gtang*/ zug pa dang chu skol gyi lcag gis brdeg go /cung zad tshad pa lhag ma snod du lus pa la gong gi phye ma gtang*/ gzer chung nad la bdud rtsi 'dra'o | | de nas rlung brtag lus yang ba dang*/ mig rtsa hur ba dang*/ tshig pa za | cho 'phrul dang*/ za zi mang*/ lus 'dar/ zas kyi ro mi tshor ba byung na sha gsar chang gsar btang*/ sre long pa lnga'am bdun gdus pa'i thang gtang*/ yid ma ches na/ bu ram dang zho sbyar la gtang*/

bla 'chol mang na tshigs pa lnga pa'am bdun pa bsreg go /'di la bcos thabs lnga yod de/ don snying gi tshad pa la phye ma'i sman gces/ snod kyi tshad pa la bshal gces/ rtsa'i tshad pa la gtar ga gces/ sha'i tshad pa la chu mda' gces/ rus pa'i tshad pa la rngul dbyung ba gces so/ /yang mkhas pas bya ba ni/ nad stobs che la lus stobs chung na yang*/ nad stobs chung la lus stobs che/ nad tshod dang sbyar ba'i dpyad kyi mchog nad stobs dang lus stobs gnyis ka che na/ dpyad kyi stobs bskyed pa gal che/ nad stobs dang lus stobs gnyis ka chung na/ zas dang*/ sman dang | dpyad thams cad 'jam pos brid la bya/ 'di la dpyad kham ches na 'chi'o | | rjes la 'jam bshal gyis bkru'o/ /rtsa 'grams gtar/ rtsa 'khrugs sbyang | tsha rims sman du shes par bya'o/ /de nas pho ba'i me drod gso ste/ dang po se 'bru dang*/ rgyam tshwa'i thang gtang*/ de nas tsho khu la spod btab la gtang*/ de nas drus thug la lga btab la gtang*/

yang na/ se 'bru/ shing tsha/ pi pi ling | sug smel/ ka ra drug 'gyur dang sbyar la chu skol gyis phul la gtang*/ des pho ba'i me drod skye bar 'gyur ro/ /spyir ma smin pa'i gtar ga sngas na/ rlung dang ldan pa'i tshad pa mi zad pa skye/ lus zungs 'dzad/ dmu 'or dang skran skye/ yang na grang ba la me drod 'chi bas spang ngo*/ /rus tshad ga ting du zhen pa zhes bya ba | lus po sngo la gyong*/ dang ga mi bde/ drag shul gang yang gnod/ khyad par du ham skyur gnod/ ja dang chu skol phan no/ /de la 'bol stan bting ba'i steng nas thul pa dro bas byibs/ chu skol tshan de brang gi 'og tu bcug la mgo bo bcug nas bstibs pas rngul dbyung ngo*/ /ma byung na chu skol khong du yang gtang*/ yang skyar la gzhug rngul dang po ma phy-is pas rngul kha snyi/ lan gsum 'am lnga'am bdun gyi tha ma phyis na tshad rlung 'dom nas mi 'chad do/ /shin tu rngul kha sra na sbang ma dang*/ shug pa dang*/ mkhan pa rnams la sings po'i kha phru btab la btso | de'i rlangs pas bdug go /tshad pa rnyings pa phyi bshal gyi man ngag go / de rnams ni glo tshad spyi'i bcos thabs so// //gnyis pa khrag gzer zhes bya ba/ rkyen spyod lam drag shul byas pa dang*/ nyin mo gnyid log mtshan mo gnyid chag pa dang*/ chang skyur 'thungs pa dang*/ mya ngan sems las ches pa dang*/ bgegs kyis kyang rkyen byas nas 'byung ngo*/ / nad kyi mtshan nyid ni/ dang po ma smin pa la lus po thams cad phrum ser khyer zhing | grang shum byed/ tshigs gzhi na/ dang ga mi bde/ lus po thams cad tsha zhing khol/ rmi lam sems las za zi mang*/ nyin par gnyid che/ mtshan mo mi 'ong | 'dar zhing lci/ mgo dang yan lag na/ de rnams spyi'i rtags so/ /de la smin par byed pa'i thabs ni/ skyu ru ra'i thang gis dwangs snyigs dbye/ de nas gtar bas nyes pa med do/ /stod du gzer drag po mi 'pho ba 'byung*/ lus lci/ khyad par du mgo bo na/

lud pa khrag tu 'ong*/ rtsa drag chu dmar/ skom dad che'o | | de la ga pur gyis rta byas la/ gi wang*/ gur gum/ bzang drug bsil gsum ka ra dang sbyar la gtang ngo*/ /stod du gzer na/ glo rtsa dang*/ snying rtsa gtar/ ru thung dang*/ mkhris pa'i gsha' rings gtar/ smad du gzer na mkhal ma la byin gzhug long la long rtsa gtar/ zug ma chogs na khrag gdon/ dkar gsum yang spang mi dgos/ zas dang spyod lam bsil la brten/ khrag gzer bcos pa'o/ /sa māpta mi thi// //gsum pa gnyan gzer bcos pa ni/ rgyu ni lta ba log pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba dang*/ lha 'dre khros pa dang*/ gnyan sar nyal ba la sogs pas gdug pa gnyan gyi nad 'byung ngo*/ /de yang stod du byung na/ gzer thung*/ rgyu ma la byung na rgyu gzer/ gre ba la byung na gag pa/ phyi ru byung na lhog pa bya ba yin pas/ rtags ni gang du smos pa dang mthun pa las/ khyad par du bya rmyang byed snying 'dod/ snying mi dga'/ ba spu ldang*/ byin pa'i nywa na/ tshig pa za/ lud pa dmar po 'ong bas | sngon du ga pur dang gtar ga spang*/ des nad mgo gtums nas khong du 'khrid do/ /de la ma nu/ kaṇḍa ka ri/ sle tres/ lga skya'i thang gtang*/ yang na 'bras bu gsum gyi 'jam thang gtang*/ des nad smin par byed do/ /smin pa'i rtags gzer 'ong*/ lus lci/ lus po sgul thabs med/ rtsa grims la chu dmar/ gong gi khol ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'chad/ lud pa smug po'am/ ser po'ang | dud ka 'ong*/ khyad par du dbugs thung*/ shes pa rngam/ khro snying 'dod/ snying ga gzer/ lce gzhung nag por 'ongs pas/ gnyan nad la khyad par du/ bgegs bcos bya/ dkon mchog mchod/ sngags gdab/ gnyan rigs kyi nad thams cad la/ hong len/ ba sha ka tig ta/ dug mo nyung*/ gla sgang*/ 'bri mog rnams kyi grang thang gtang*/ slong byed kyi sman/ gla rtsi dang*/ shu dag dum cig gtang*/ de nas ka ra'am/ mngar gsum gang rnyed mthe bong tsam cig btang la nad bsdu/ de nas dngos gzhi'i sman zhi sbyang gnyis gang rung gtang ngo

| | gtso bor thar nu 'o mar btul ba dang*/ chu rtsa/ dur byed/ khron bu/ hong len gtang*/ de la glo mang la lud pa dmar na sman gyi steng du 'tshal dang*/ rgya skyegs khu ba gtang*/ lud pa ser na/ skyer pa/ yung ba/ gi wang*/ gur gum bsnan la gtang*/ lud pa kham nag byung na/ dom mkhris/ brag zhun/ gla ba bsnan | lud pa nag po byung na/ bse ru bsnan/ mi 'gog na star bu bsnan/ klad gzer la/ tig ta dang*/ ru rta bsnan/ gag pa la shu dag dang*/ dbyi mong bsnan | gang btang yang*/ a ru ra dum re gtang*/ skyug tu mi gzhug go /pho ba na na so phag gam/ yos dugs bya/ des nad thams cad 'khru bar 'gyur/ 'khrus nas chu skol gtang*/ 'khru ba drags nas rlung skyes na/ sre long bsdus pa'i khu ba dang rus khu mar gsar rtseg bcad la gtang*/ 'khrus zhan nas chad lhag lus na/ cu gang*/ li shi gi wang*/ gur gum/ tsandan dkar po rnams zhib par btags la gtang*/ ka ra mi gtang*/ nad slong yin no/ /bshal khrag tu 'byams na/ gur gum/ li shi dom mkhris/ padma rakta/ shing tsha/ mkhan pa dkar po rnams zhib par byas la sbrang rtsis mgo bsdus la gtang*/ des nges par 'tsho'o/ /nas dkar mo'i zan sbru ma dang*/ drus thug gtang*/ mjug tu sha gsar mar gsar gtang*/ dkar/ skyur/ mngar/ tsha/ sgog btsong*/ nyin par gyi gnyid/ drag shul rnams ma brtas bar du spang ngo*/ /nad pa stod gzer la rtsa zhan | lud pa skya sob tu 'ong*/ dbugs thung*/ gre ba sog nam tshang mi bde ba dang | sna nas chu ser 'ong ba dang*/ mig gyen la blta ba dang*/ kha khu yis 'debs na/ srog pa rtsa la shor ba yin no/ /shes pa 'khrul ba dang*/ rgyu ma rul nas dud khur 'khru/ gcod sman btang na slar la 'khru ba rnams 'chi bdag gi kha ru tshud nges pa yin pas spang ngo*/ /de la sman btang na/ gzhan la mi 'gos so// gzer thung gso ba'i gdams ngag khyad par can bdud rtsi yang thigs rdzogs so || || ༈ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dang po mkhris pa'i nad kyi gzhi ni/ mchin pa'i khrag tshad las lhag pa dang*/ ngal dub drag po dang*/ me tshan dang*/ nyi tshan la gnyid cher log pa dang | chang skyur mang po 'thungs pas mkhris pa thang la lhags pa'o/ /de la mkhris nad spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ mig sprin dang*/ lce 'og gi rtsa dang*/ rna rgyab dang | lag mthil dang*/ mchan 'og dang*/ sna rtse rnams ser ba dang*/ chu dmar nag 'dra ba dang*/ phyi sa dkar po bag zan 'dra ba dang*/ skom dad che la kha kha ba dang*/ pho ba cung zad gyong zhing*/ sgyid pa shin tu skyur ba'o/ /mkhris pa kṣa ya nag po ni/ rtags de rnams kyi steng du sen mo nag por 'gro ba dang*/ lus po la phrug pas tshim pa med pa dang*/ skra dang smin ma 'byi ba'o/ /mkhris pa rtsa rgyug ni/ spyi rtags rnams kyi steng du/ ro stod gyong zhing cung zad ser/ lus po dang snabs la yang cung zad ser po 'byung*/ zas dang gar mi 'ong la/ kha kha/ mig sngar sngo dmar du 'ong*/ mkhris pa za byed ni/ za zhing phrug na chu ser 'ong*/ 'brum pa ser po 'ong*/ rlung gi stobs kyis zhugs pa ni/ spyi rtags rnams kyi steng du rna ba 'ur ba dang*/ gnyid chung*/ shes pa 'phyo bar 'ong*/ bad kan gyi stobs kyis zhugs na/ spyi rtags rnams kyi steng du pho ba ldem pa dang*/ shed chung ba dang*/ phyi sa bag zan lta bur 'byung*/ snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud pa ni/ spyi rtags kyi steng du mgo bo la lud na/ mgo bo 'khor zhing klad pa na/ mtshog ma rdol ba snyam byed/ nyi ma la 'dug na na ba'o/ /mchin pa la lud na/ mchin pa'i steng du na/ lud pa skyur na kha la 'khri/ glo ba la lud na kha kha la/ glo mang*/ pho ba la lud na gsus pa che/ khrag sla mo 'khru'o/ /thams cad la mkhris pa cung zad skyug go /lus zungs kyi mkhris pa gnas gyur pa ni/ rtsa la lus grang shum byed do/ /mkhris pa sha ser ni/ nyam shed chung*/ khong sbo/ /chu 'thungs kyang kha kha | rdzas dkar po yang ser por mthong*/

snga dro dang*/ dgongs ka bsil dus bag re bde'o/ /de la mkhris pa bcos pa la gsum ste/ dang po bsdu/ bar du sbyang | tha ma brtas par bya'o/ /bsdu ba ni gser gyi me tog dom mkhris/ a ru ra | dug mo nyung gi thang yang yang gtang*/ des pho ba mi bder song na 'dus pa yin pas sbyang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa sbyang ba ni/ a ru ra la dur byid kyi khu ba bstim la/ de btsos nas bskams pa dang*/ a ru ra zan gyi nang du gtums la lci me la bsregs te/ zan tshos/ a ru ra ma tshig pa ser tsam song ba gcig dang | a ru ra mchu snyung cig dur byid/ thar nu dang gser gyi me tog rnams zhib tu btags te/ ba yi chu la btab ste gtang ngo*/ /rjes la sogs pa bshal spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di ni a ru ra btso bsregs rjen gsum gyi sbyor ba zhes bya ba ste | mkhris pa dang*/ dug la 'di las lhag pa med do/ /gsum pa brtas par bya ba ni/ chang gsar pa dang*/ ba mar gsar pa dang*/ dar ba gsar pa rnams pho ba'i me drod dang sbyar la ci rigs su gtang ngo*/ /lus po brtas nas yun ring du lon pa dang*/ dgos na yang bskyar la gtang*/ bshal rjes ma yin pa la lug sha dang chang spang*/ ra sha dang g.yag sha spang ngo*/ /dkar dang ba sha gsar pa bsten/ sgog chu tshwa med la zan spags/ rlan dang nyi ma spang*/ me btsa' bya ru mi rung ngo*/ /spyir thams cad la rtse'u chung dang ru thung gtar la/ ba le ka dang*/ tig ta gtang ngo*/ /zhi byed kyi sman la gser gyi me tog bong nga dkar po/ gur gum | dug nyung*/ brag zhun/ utpal/ ba sha ka yung ba rnams gtang ngo*/ kha cig mkhris pa'i rigs mi 'byed par/ bsil sman dang*/ gtar ga 'ba' zhig byed de/ de ni bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du nad dang lus zungs gnyis ka 'dzad do/ /mkhris pa grang ba'i rigs la/ dang po rgyam tshwa gsum pa'i thang gtang | bar du da lis bdun pa bungs bskyed la gtang*/ se 'bru/ tsha ba gsum | sug smel/ shing tsha/ ka ko la/ rgyam tshwa/

ka ra sbyar la gtang ngo*/ / mdor na drod sman 'ba' zhig gis bcos so/ /drod sman btang bas khams mi bde nyog pa snyam byed na/ bred mi dgos so/ /de'i rjes la bags kyis lce bde la | mig dang*/ lce mi ser du 'gro'o/ /spyir mkhris pa la man ngag tu byas pa la | grang ba'i dus dang*/ tsha ba'i dus gnyis yod de/ dang po zla ba phyed nas zhag nyi shu'i bar du chu dmar ba dang*/ mig ser ba tshor ma thag ni bar dus zhes bya ste/ da lis bdun pa 'ba' zhig btang bas 'tsho'o/ /'di'i dus su gtar ga dang*/ bsil btang na nges par 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /dus yun ring po lon te | skra 'byi ba dang*/ sen mo nag por song nas/ drod gnod pas bshal gyis bcos pa man ngag yin no/ /gtar ga byas na khrag mkhris par 'ong ste/ gang la yang phugs su gnod do/ /snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud pa la/ bag tsam gtar yang drag ste/ phal cher gtar na 'chi'o/ /spyir yang ma zhu bas rgyu byas pa'i mkhris pa khong na song bas drod bcos bya'o/ /da lis bdun pa ni ba lu'i lo ma/ na le sham/ sga skya/ pi pi ling*/ dang po'i cha res gang nas gang du skyed/ shing tsha dang | sug smel/ ba lu'i lo ma'i phyed/ pi pi ling gi brgyad 'gyur ka ra gtang ngo | | mkhris pa skye ba'i kha zas sha rul sungs dang*/ mar rnying*/ thud rul/ snum khur/ mar nagasgog pa/ chang nyes/ skyur po/ zho skyur/ mdor na drod la 'ju dka' ba'i zas zos nas/ nyin par gnyid log pa dang*/ me dang nyi ma la 'dug drags pa dang*/ las drag shul byas pas mkhris pa 'khrugs te mig gi nad du gyur pa'o/ /de dag ni mkhris pa tsha ba'i nad do/ /dang po rlung skye ba'i rgyu 'ga' zhig gi rkyen gyis mkhris pa yul bton te/ phyir gram nas mig la sogs pa ser por byas pa dang*/ gnyis pa bad kan skyes pa'i zas snum 'thungs pa'am/ tshil bu zos pa dang*/ chang ma zhu ba dang*/ mkhris pa'i lam bkag nas/ phyir yan lag dang mig la sogs pa ser por 'gyur ba'o/

/'di gnyis mkhris pa grang ba las gyur pa'o/ /mjug tsha ba chom pa'i tshe tshigs pa bco lnga pa la me btsa' byas kyang btub/ 'di ni khyad par mchog tu gyur pa'i man ngag yin no/ /gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las mkhris pa sgos bcos kyi le'u rdzogs so// //༈ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhal ma sgos bcos kyi man ngag 'di la/ dang po mkhal ma surya zhes bya ba las drag shul byas pa las byung ste/ mkhal rked lci zhing*/ dang ga 'grib | rna ba mi gsang*/ sha skam mo/ /de la dang po dugs bya/ bar du thang gtang | tha ma gtar gyis tsha rengs gdul lo/ /des ma phan na/ zas bsil gyis bcol/ rtsa bshal bya/ rjes la gur gum bdun pa gtang*/ rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar gtang*/ mkhal gsang bsregs/ mkhal ma zag khu zhes bya ba'i khu ba rnag dang bcas pa chu'i nang du sngon nam/ rjes la 'dzag na zug che'o/ /de la rtsa bshal gtang*/ 'jam rtsi bsten/ rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar bsten/ sngo ngad dang zas bcud med spang*/ rta rgyug pa dang*/ bang dang*/ mchongs dang*/ nyal po rnams mkhal ma'i dgra yin pas spang*/ mkhal ma da rgan zhes bya ba/ tshigs dang bshul sha thams cad na/ brdungs pa'am/ btsir na phan pa snyam byed/ skabs su rked pa na/ rgyab lag byas na bde ba snyam byed/ mjug tshigs 'thon nas sgur por 'gro/ de la bdud rtsi'i dugs bya/ bsku mnye bya/ rtsa bshal gtang*/ me btsa' bya/ zas bcud la bsten/ da byid dang rtsa ba lnga bsten no/ /mkhal ma chu shor zhes bya ba/ tshigs pa bco brgyad pa man chad na/ spyi bo'i 'bogs mtshams g.yo zhing na/ brla sul dang*/ byin sul 'phro zhing na'o/ /de la dang po dugs yang yang bya/ skyu ru ra dang*/ sle tres kyi thang gis bsdus la mkhal rtsa gtar | lag pas sleb pa'i brla sul du thur ma rgyab la chu ser dbyung*/ mkhal gsang gi na sar me btsa' bya'o/ /mkhal ma rde'u zhes bya ba 'bras bu dang*/ spu ltag na phyis na phan pa snyam byed do/

/ de la da byid/ lcam pa/ ra mnye ba/ sdig srin/ ram bu rnams brgyad 'gyur du sbyar la chang gis nus pa bskyed la ri bong gi ril ma tsam lto stong la gtang ngo*/ /des rde'u'i nad sel lo/ /skran yod na lus bsgyur/ langs na tsha shags shags byed do/ /de la rdo me la bsregs pa dmar po re bal dang*/ pha tshe chu ru btsug nas lhod lhod mang du byas la/ na sar snam bus gcud la yun ring du bdug go /yang ra dang khyi ma gtogs pa'i rus pa yib ma sna tshogs mthe bong tsam du brdungs pa la yun ring du btso/ /de dong du me du ba med pa'i steng du bzhag la/ mtshams rnams 'dag pas byug phru ba'i kha phad hrul gyis mthug tu bkab ste/ de la skran brlan la bdug de steng nas mal chas bstibs/ skran rigs thams cad la de ltar bya'o/ /spyir dpyi bshal/ mkhal rked na/ rkang pa sbrid/ g.yal dang sbrid pa byung na skad ngan 'chor/ de thams cad la lug gi mkhal ma mar du btsos la gtang*/ long rtsa gnyis dang/ mju gu chung gtar/ mkhal gsang bsreg go

/gso dpyad bdud rtsi thigs pa las mkhal ma sgos su bcos pa'i le'u'o/ /sa māpta mi thi// //༈ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtar ga'i man ngag zung rngu phyir 'dren zhes bya ba 'di la/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i zug rngu phyi 'byin te/ g.yeng ba med par bsnyal thag legs par bsdam/ chu grang dang rdo grang la sogs pa bsogs la/ nad pa lus po dros pa shes pa ma bred par byas la/ gtsag bu tshad dang ldan pa rnon po brdar te/ gdab lugs du ma yod kyang*/ gnyis len dang*/ dol chod dang*/ glo phug bya ste/ rtsa chen po rnams sgang gshag bya/ byin po dol chod bya ste/ sman pa lag 'dris pa gal che'o/ /de yang rtsa chen po rnams su sum cha blang*/ 'bring po phyed blang*/ phra mo rnams sum gnyis blang ngo*/ /mgo'i rtsa dol chod bya ste/ chod kyang skyon med do | | mgo'i sha mthug po dang*/ sha las byed dang*/ 'phar rtsa ma gtogs pa rnams gtar ro/ /rkang pa'i sne sa dang*/ nywa dang chu ba dang*/ 'gul rtsa la mi gdab bo/ /dang po nad la yid ma ches na/ snod kha bag tsam gtar la khrag lta ste | khrag bzang na bzhag khrag ngan la yab chen mang du dbyung ngo*/ /de yang dar dmar po bzhin/ dmar la gsal na khrag bzang ba yin te/ de la lus brten nas zungs khrag ces bya'o/ /mdor na nad rnying pa la sogs pa/ don snod gang la babs/ ngo shes na de rang gi rtsa la gdab bo/ khrag sba byung na rdo ba chur bcug la mnye/ khrag ma chod na rdo grang mo/ che bya'i phod rma khar glan/ khrag rjes bag re lus kyang sman btang bas 'byangs te nyam nga mi dgos so/ /da ni gtar ba'i bye brag bstan par bya ste/ spyi gtsug gtar ba ni/ rna ba gnyis mdun du ltab la srad bu gtang*/ ltag pa'i sdud khungs nas/ sna rtser srad bu btang ba'i rgya gram la gtar na rtsa byed chen po byung ba dang*/ mgo lci zhing 'khor ba dang*/ ltag dgyer song ba rnams la phan no/

/gal te khrag mchod na/ rkang mthil du me btsa' gdab bo/ /dpral ba'i skra mtshams na yar sor bzhi 'jal par gtar na | mtshog ma lci la mig phugs su zug cing na ba dang*/ bad mkhris las gyur pa'i rims kyis mgo 'khor zhing na ba la phan no/ /rna ba'i phyi ngos sna'i rtsa na spu 'jam po gyen du 'khyil ba yod de/ gtar la mes kha bsrung*/ ltag khung g.yas g.yon skra mtshams nas gyen la sor bzhi bcal ba'i gdong na/ ltag rtsa nag po bya ba gnyis yod de/ gtsag kha gyen la bstan la gshags/ des gnya' ba rengs pa dang*/ mjings pa 'gyur mi shes pa dang*/ chu rgyus snad nas ltag pa dgye bor song ba la phan no/ /dpral ba la rtsa gsum yod de/ dbus ma la mkhris pa gser mdung zhes bya ba/ de gtar bas mkhris pa rgyas pa dang*/ ston dpyid mgo bo dang*/ nyi mas dros na mtshog ma lci ba dang*/ chang nad drag po kun la phan no/ /mig gnyis kyi gong na 'phar rtsa re gnas pas/ skra mtshams su gtar na/ mig tshags pa'i nad thams cad sel lo/ /sna'i rtse mo nas spyi gtsug tu srad bu btang la/ de bltab pa'i sar skra mtshams phye la gtar/ des kyang mig gi nad la phan no/ /mig phugs kyi rtsa gnyis gtar na/ khrag gi ling tog gis mig khebs pa dang*/ zug gzer che ba la phan no/ /rna ba'i rtse mo nas sor bzhi gyen la bcal bar gtar na mgo phyed na ba la phan no/ /lce 'og gi rtsa gnyis gtar na kha kha ba dang*/ kha skam pa dang*/ lce phugs su bros pa la phan no || rgyal mo gab rtsa snying gi lung thag ces bya ste/ mchu 'thems su bcug la/ rtsa nag chur byung ba la gtar/ des mchu'i bad kan dang*/ mcher ba'i nad la phan no/ /de ltar rna ba'i nad la rna ba'i rtsa gtar/ sna'i nad la sna'i rtse gtar na/ mig skam tshags la phan no/ /spyir skra mtshams yan chad kyi 'phar rtsa rnams la gtar na gtar ba'i nyes pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /ro stod kyi gzer thams cad la rtse'u chung g.yas g.yon/ ske la mas yar sor bzhi bcal bar gtar na phan no/

/glo ba'i a so li ga gnyis na gru mo'i khug na rtsa gnyis yod de/ de la glo drug mgo yang zer/ de gnyis bsnol te gtar bas glo la rnag khrag 'ong ba dang/ glo la khrag rgyas te smug rbab tu song ba dang*/ stod na zhing gzer ba dang*/ nyin dgung nam dgung la lci zhing dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ glo'i dbugs mi bde ba la phan no | | glo ba'i dpung rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis gtar na/ rims las gyur pa'i stod gzer drag po dang*/ glo rtsa khrag gis rgyas te gzer ba dang*/ glo rtsa khrag gis rgyas pa'i skyon gyis 'gram pa g.yas g.yon du gzer ba dang*/ mgo la lha 'thems byung ba la phan no/ /de'i rgyud gru mo'i khugs kyi zur na glo ba'i zur rtsa zhes bya ba yod de/ de gtar na/ glo dang*/ mchin pa dang*/ stod kyi tshad pa dang*/ lag pa sbrid cing na ba dang*/ rtag tu sna khrag 'dzag pa dang*/ zas yi gar mi 'ong ba dang*/ glo la khrag mtshal lta bu 'ong ba dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ byang khog la nad phog pa rnams la phan no/ /mchan 'og nas 'khris nas gru mo'i nang du byung ba de la/ drug mgo chen po zhes bya ste/ de las gyes pa'i rtsa lnga yod/ phyir 'khyug pa ru thung zhes bya ste/ de'i gyes mtshams nas sor bzhi bcal bar gtar na mchin pa khrag gis rgyas pa dang*/ mchin khrag pho bar ltung ba dang*/ tsha ba las gyur pa'i rgyu gzer dang*/ mchin pa 'khrugs pa'i skyon gyis mig tshags pa dang*/ 'gram par zug gzer 'ong ba dang*/ rtsib log gzer zhing mchin dri kha skor na ba dang*/ dug gis mchin pa rgyas pa dang*/ bad kan smug po mchin pa la zhugs te/ khrag rgyas pa la phan no/ /de nas mar sor brgyad bcal bar gtar na/ dug nad rnying pa la phan no/ /ru thung gi rtse mo mkhrig ma'i phyi rol long bu'i gdong du gtar na/ ma'i khong du rgyun chad par song nas ma'i rum nas mig tshags pa la phan no/ /de'i nang ngos su gyes pa'i rtsa de ni mchin pa'i zam pa zhes bya ste/

mchin pa'i nad la phan no/ /de'i nang gi rtsa de mkhris pa'i gsha' rings zhes bya ba yin/ de gtar bas mkhris pa pho bar lud pa dang*/ mig ser ba dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rims nad dang*/ bal nad mig ser dang*/ mkhris pa'i skyon gyis mgo bo na ba dang*/ mig ser ba dang*/ ling tog gsar pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i tshad nad yun ring gis dang ga 'gags pa rnams la phan no/ /de'i nang ngos kyi rtsa snod kha zhes bya ste/ de gtar na snod kyi tsha ba sel lo/ /de'i nang du byung ba'i rtsa de ni/ snying gi a so li ga zhes bya ste/ de gtar bas snying rtsa khrag gis khengs pa dang*/ stod lci zhing yi ga mi bde ba dang | rims nad snying la zhen pa dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ stod lci zhing nu mchin gzer ba dang*/ snying gi nad thams cad la phan no/ /de snying gi 'phar rtsa'i steng na gnas pas shin tu gzab bo/ /a so dang*/ glo'i zur rtsa 'dom pa'i rtsa la gtar na/ glo snying gnyis ka'i nad la phan no/ /lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i rgyab na rtsa gnyis yod de/ gcig rgyab rtsa drug 'dus zhes bya ste/ de gtar na ro stod rgyas pa dang*/ rgyab tu gzer ba dang*/ khrag ro rnying pa la phan no/ /de'i phyi ngos rgyab rtsa chen po zhes bya ste/ de gtar bas rgyab smad dang*/ sog 'dab na ba la phan no/ /de'i phyi ngos rtsa phran yin te/ rgyab rtsa 'khun bu zhes bya ste/ de gtar na mchin pa snyong bu dang*/ mchin pa skyed 'khor gyi nad dang*/ mchin pa klad grangs kyi nad dang*/ ro rgyab 'byar zhing na ba dang*/ mchin pa na ting byed pa dang*/ kha zas yi gar mi 'ong ba la phan no/ /mtheb mdzub bar na yang mtshon gang bcal ba na glo ba'i skyor gong zhes bya ba yod de/ de gtar na glo ba'i lud pa dmar ba dang*/ gre ba 'dzer ba dang*/ skad 'gags pa'i nad la phan no/ / mthe bong gi rgyab ngos na/ snying rtsa yod de/ de gtar bas snying gi tsha ba sel lo// mdzub mo'i rgyab na glo rtsa yod de/
